title.zh: 卷五 本紀第五 元帝
title.raw: 卷五 本紀第五 元帝 Volume 5: Emperor Yuan

sentences.zh: 梁書卷第五 本紀第五

translations.literal: Book of Liang, Volume 5, Basic Annals 5
translations.idiomatic: Book of Liang, Volume 5, Annals 5

sentences.zh: 世祖孝元皇帝諱繹，字世誠，小字七符，高祖第七子也。

translations.literal: The Taizong Emperor Xiaoyuan was tabooed Yi, style name Shicheng, childhood name Qifu; he was the seventh son of the Gaozu.
translations.idiomatic: Taizong Emperor Xiaoyuan, personal name Yi, courtesy name Shicheng, childhood name Qifu, was Gaozu's seventh son.

sentences.zh: 天監七年八月丁巳生。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, day dingsi, year 7 of Tianjian, he was born.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi in the eighth month of Tianjian 7 he was born.

sentences.zh: 十三年，封湘東郡王，邑二千戶。

translations.literal: In year 13 he was enfeoffed as Prince of Xiangdong commandery with a fief of two thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: In year 13 he was made Prince of Xiangdong with a fief of two thousand households.

sentences.zh: 初爲寧遠將軍、會稽太守，入爲侍中、宣威將軍、丹陽尹。

translations.literal: At first he was Remote Pacification General and Kuaiji Administrator; he entered court as Attendant, Proclaiming Might General, and Danyang Intendant.
translations.idiomatic: He was first Remote Pacification General and Kuaiji administrator, then Attendant, Proclaiming Might General, and Danyang intendant.

sentences.zh: 普通七年，出爲使持節、都督荊湘郢益寧南梁六州諸軍事、西中郎將、荊州刺史。

translations.literal: In year 7 of Putong he went out as Bearer of the Staff, Commander over military affairs in the six provinces Jing, Xiang, Ying, Yi, Ning, and South Liang, made Colonel of the Western Center and Jingzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: In Putong 7 he went out as Bearer of the Staff, commander of Jing, Xiang, Ying, Yi, Ning, and South Liang, Colonel of the Western Center, and Jingzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 中大通四年，進號平西將軍。

translations.literal: In year 4 of Zhongdatong his title was advanced to General Who Pacifies the West.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhongdatong 4 he was promoted to General Who Pacifies the West.

sentences.zh: 大同元年，進號安西將軍。

translations.literal: In year 1 of Datong his title was advanced to General Who Pacifies the West.
translations.idiomatic: In Datong 1 he was promoted to General Who Pacifies the West.

sentences.zh: 三年，進號鎮西將軍。

translations.literal: In year 3 his title was advanced to General Who Secures the West.
translations.idiomatic: In Datong 3 he was promoted to General Who Secures the West.

sentences.zh: 五年，入爲安右將軍、護軍將軍，領石頭戍軍事。

translations.literal: In year 5 he entered court as General of the Right Guard and Protector-General, supervising military affairs at the Shitou garrison.
translations.idiomatic: In year 5 he entered court as General of the Right Guard and protector-general with Shitou garrison duties.

sentences.zh: 六年，出爲使持節、都督江州諸軍事、鎮南將軍、江州刺史。

translations.literal: In year 6 he went out as Bearer of the Staff, Commander over military affairs in Jiangzhou, made General Who Secures the South and Jiangzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: In year 6 he went out as Bearer of the Staff, Jiangzhou commander, General Who Secures the South, and Jiangzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 太清元年，徙爲使持節、都督荊雍湘司郢寧梁南北秦九州諸軍事、鎮西將軍、荊州刺史。

translations.literal: In year 1 of Taiqing he was transferred as Bearer of the Staff, Commander over military affairs in the nine provinces Jing, Yong, Xiang, Si, Ying, Ning, Liang, North and South Qin, made General Who Secures the West and Jingzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: In Taiqing 1 he was transferred Bearer of the Staff, commander of Jing, Yong, Xiang, Si, Ying, Ning, Liang, and the two Qin, General Who Secures the West, and Jingzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 三年三月，侯景寇沒京師。

translations.literal: In the third month, year 3, Hou Jing raided and captured the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of year 3 Hou Jing stormed and took the capital.

sentences.zh: 四月，太子舍人蕭韶至江陵宣密詔，以世祖爲侍中、假黃鉞、大都督中外諸軍事、司徒承製，餘如故。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, Crown Prince's Gentleman Xiao Shao arrived at Jiangling with a secret edict, making the Taizong Attendant, provisionally Bearer of the Yellow Axe, Grand Commander of all military affairs within and without, administering as Minister of Education by imperial order, the rest unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month crown prince gentleman Xiao Shao reached Jiangling with a secret edict appointing Taizong Attendant, provisional Bearer of the Yellow Axe, grand commander of all armies, acting as Minister of Education, other posts unchanged.

sentences.zh: 是月，世祖徵兵於湘州，湘州刺史河東王譽拒不遣。

translations.literal: That month the Taizong levied troops in Xiangzhou; Xiangzhou Inspector Prince of Hedong Yu refused to send them.
translations.idiomatic: That month Taizong raised troops in Xiangzhou; Xiangzhou inspector Prince Yu of Hedong refused to dispatch them.

sentences.zh: 六月丙午，遣世子方等帥衆討譽，戰所敗死。

translations.literal: On bingwu in the sixth month he sent the Heir Fangdeng to lead troops to attack Yu; defeated in battle, Fangdeng died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu in the sixth month he sent the heir Fangdeng against Yu; defeated in battle, Fangdeng was killed.

sentences.zh: 七月，又遣鎮兵將軍鮑泉代討譽。

translations.literal: In the seventh month he again sent Pacifying Troops General Bao Quan to replace him in attacking Yu.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month he again sent Pacifying Troops General Bao Quan to replace him against Yu.

sentences.zh: 九月乙卯，雍州刺史岳陽王詧舉兵反，來寇江陵，世祖嬰城拒守。

translations.literal: On yimao in the ninth month Yongzhou Inspector Prince of Yueyang Cha raised troops in revolt and came to attack Jiangling; the Taizong closed the city and held it.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao in the ninth month Yueyang prince Cha, Yongzhou inspector, rebelled and attacked Jiangling; Taizong shut the city and defended.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，詧將杜掞與其兄弟及楊混，各率其衆來降。

translations.literal: On yichou Cha's general Du Shan and his brothers and Yang Hun each led their troops to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Cha's general Du Shan, his brothers, and Yang Hun each led their forces to surrender.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，詧遁走。

translations.literal: On bingyin Cha fled.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Cha fled.

sentences.zh: 鮑泉攻湘州不克，又遣左衛將軍王僧辯代將。

translations.literal: Bao Quan attacked Xiangzhou without success; he again sent Left Guard General Wang Senbian to replace the commander.
translations.idiomatic: Bao Quan failed to take Xiangzhou and again sent Left Guard General Wang Senbian to replace the commander.

sentences.zh: 二月甲戌，衡陽內史周弘直表言鳳皇見郡界。

translations.literal: On jiaxu in the second month Hengyang Intendant Zhou Hongzhi memorialized that a phoenix had appeared within the commandery bounds.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu in the second month Hengyang intendant Zhou Hongzhi reported a phoenix within the commandery.

sentences.zh: 夏五月辛未，王僧辯克湘州，斬河東王譽，湘州平。

translations.literal: In summer, the fifth month, day xinwei, Wang Senbian took Xiangzhou, beheaded Prince of Hedong Yu, and Xiangzhou was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei in the fifth month of summer Wang Senbian took Xiangzhou, executed Prince Yu of Hedong, and pacified the province.

sentences.zh: 六月，江夏王大款、山陽王大成、宜都王大封自信安間道來奔。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Princes Dakuen of Jiangxia, Dacheng of Shanyang, and Dafeng of Yidu came fleeing by the Xin'an bypath.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Princes Dakuen of Jiangxia, Dacheng of Shanyang, and Dafeng of Yidu fled by the Xin'an route.

sentences.zh: 九月辛酉，以前郢州刺史南平王恪爲中衛將軍、尚書令、開府儀同三司，中撫軍將軍世子方諸爲郢州刺史，左衛將軍王僧辯爲領軍將軍。

translations.literal: On xinyou in the ninth month former Yingzhou Inspector Prince of Nanping Ke was made Central Guard General, Director of the Masters of Writing with honors equal to the Three Lords, the Heir Fangzhu Central Pacifying Troops General and Yingzhou Inspector, Left Guard General Wang Senbian Leader of the Palace Gentlemen.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou in the ninth month former Ying inspector Prince Ke of Nanping became Central Guard General, Director of the Masters of Writing with Three Lords honors; heir Fangzhu became Ying inspector; Left Guard Wang Senbian became leader of palace gentlemen.

sentences.zh: 改封大款爲臨川郡王，大成爲桂陽郡王，大封爲汝南郡王。

translations.literal: Dakuen was re-enfeoffed Prince of Linchuan, Dacheng Prince of Guiyang, Dafeng Prince of Runan.
translations.idiomatic: Dakuen was re-enfeoffed Prince of Linchuan, Dacheng Prince of Guiyang, Dafeng Prince of Runan.

sentences.zh: 是月，任約進寇西陽、武昌，遣左衛將軍徐文盛、右衛將軍陰子春、太子右衛率蕭慧正、嶲州刺史席文獻等下武昌拒約。

translations.literal: That month Ren Yue advanced to raid Xiyang and Wuchang; he sent Left Guard General Xu Wensheng, Right Guard General Yin Zichun, Heir's Right Guard Colonel Xiao Huizheng, and Guizhou Inspector Xi Wennian and others downstream to Wuchang to resist Yue.
translations.idiomatic: That month Ren Yue raided Xiyang and Wuchang; Left Guard Xu Wensheng, Right Guard Yin Zichun, heir's right guard colonel Xiao Huizheng, Guizhou inspector Xi Wennian, and others went down to Wuchang against him.

sentences.zh: 以中衛將軍、尚書令、開府儀同三司南平王恪爲荊州刺史，鎮武陵。

translations.literal: Central Guard General, Director of the Masters of Writing with Three Lords honors Prince of Nanping Ke was made Jingzhou Inspector, stationed at Wuling.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Ke of Nanping, central guard general and director with Three Lords honors, became Jingzhou inspector at Wuling.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲子，南平王恪、侍中臨川王大款、桂陽王大成、散騎常侍江安侯圓正、侍中左衛將軍張綰、司徒左長史曇等府州國一千人奉牋曰：

translations.literal: On jiazi in the eleventh month Prince Ke of Nanping, Attendant Prince Dakuen of Linchuan, Prince Dacheng of Guiyang, Palace Attendant Jiang'an Marquis Yuanzheng, Attendant Left Guard Zhang Chuan, Minister of Education Left Chief Clerk Dan, and others—one thousand men from offices, provinces, and kingdoms—submitted a memorial saying:
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi in the eleventh month Prince Ke, Attendant Dakuen, Prince Dacheng, palace attendant Marquis Yuanzheng of Jiang'an, Attendant Left Guard Zhang Chuan, Minister of Education left chief clerk Dan, and a thousand men from offices, provinces, and kingdoms submitted a memorial:

sentences.zh: 竊以嵩岳旣峻，山川出雲；

translations.literal: We venture to think that since Song Mountain stands lofty, mountains and rivers send forth clouds;
translations.idiomatic: We note that since lofty Song Mountain sends mountains and rivers forth in cloud;

sentences.zh: 大國有蕃，申甫惟翰。

translations.literal: a great state has its screen, Shen and Fu are its pillars.
translations.idiomatic: a great state has its bulwark and Shen and Fu as its pillars.

sentences.zh: 豈非皇建斯極，以位爲寶；

translations.literal: Is it not that when royal ordering reaches its pole, position is the treasure;
translations.idiomatic: Is it not that when royal order reaches its height, rank is the treasure;

sentences.zh: 聖教辨方，慎名與器。

translations.literal: when sage teaching distinguishes regions, names and vessels are carefully kept?
translations.idiomatic: when sage teaching marks the regions, names and regalia are kept with care?

sentences.zh: 是知太尉佐帝，重華表黃玉之符，司空相土，伯禹降玄圭之錫。

translations.literal: Thus we know the Grand Marshal assists the emperor, Chonghua displayed the yellow jade tally; the Minister of Works surveyed the earth, Yu the Great received the black jade gift.
translations.idiomatic: Thus the grand marshal aids the emperor as Chonghua showed the yellow jade sign; the minister of works surveyed the land as Yu received the black jade gift.

sentences.zh: 伏惟明公大王殿下，命世應期，挺生將聖。

translations.literal: We venture to think that illustrious Duke and Royal Highness, fated for the age, arose bearing the sage.
translations.idiomatic: We venture: illustrious Duke and Royal Highness, born for the age, arose bearing the sage.

sentences.zh: 忠爲令德，孝實天經，地切應、韓，寄深旦、奭，五品斯訓，七政以齊，志存社稷，功濟屯險。

translations.literal: Loyalty is the chief virtue, filial piety the heaven's constant—the earth joins Ying and Han, the charge joins Dan and Shi; the five ranks are thereby instructed, the seven regulators align; will lodges in altar and state, achievement crosses hard straits.
translations.idiomatic: Loyalty is supreme virtue, filial piety heaven's norm; the charge is deep as Dan and Shi; the five ranks are taught and seven directors aligned; will rests in state, merit crosses danger.

sentences.zh: 夷狄內侵，枕戈泣血，鯨鯢未掃，投袂勤王，能使遊魂請盟以屈膝，醜徒銜璧而讋氣。

translations.literal: When barbarians invaded within, he slept on his spear and wept blood; while whales and krakens were not swept away he cast aside his sleeves to serve the king—he could make wandering spirits beg treaty on bent knee and ugly bandits bear jade on their lips in shame.
translations.idiomatic: When aliens invaded he slept on spear and wept blood; until foes were swept he cast sleeves aside for the king—foes begged treaty on bent knee and bandits bore jade in shame.

sentences.zh: 親蕃外叛，釁均吳、楚，義討申威，兵不血刃。

translations.literal: Kin and marches rebelled without; trouble matched Wu and Chu; righteous punishment extended prestige, arms without bloodshed.
translations.idiomatic: Kin and marches rebelled alike; trouble matched Wu and Chu; righteous punishment needed no bloodshed.

sentences.zh: 湘波自息，非築杜弢之壘；

translations.literal: Xiang's waves stilled themselves—not building Du Tao's ramparts;
translations.idiomatic: The Xiang stilled without building Du Tao's ramparts;

sentences.zh: 峴山離貳，不伐劉表之城。

translations.literal: Mount Xian stood apart without attacking Liu Biao's city.
translations.idiomatic: Mount Xian stood apart without storming Liu Biao's city.

sentences.zh: 九江致梗，二別殊派，才命戈船，底定灊、霍。

translations.literal: Jiujiang brought obstruction; the two branches differed; with talent he ordered war-boats and settled Qian and Huo.
translations.idiomatic: Jiujiang was troubled; branches split; war-boats were ordered and Qian and Huo were settled.

sentences.zh: 溯流窮討，路絕窺窬，胡兵侵界，鐵馬霧合，神規獨運，皆卽梟懸，翻同翅折，遂修職貢。

translations.literal: Upstream he pursued to the end, roads blocked all spying; when Hu troops crossed the border iron horses joined like mist, his divine plan alone operated—all at once were hung head-down, wings folded as if broken, and tribute was restored.
translations.idiomatic: Pursuing upstream, roads blocked spies; when Hu troops crossed and iron horses massed like mist, his plan alone worked—heads hung, wings folded, tribute restored.

sentences.zh: 梁、漢合契，肆犀利之兵，巴、漢俱下，竭驍勇之陣。

translations.literal: Liang and Han joined pact and deployed sharp troops; Ba and Han both descended and exhausted bold arrays.
translations.idiomatic: Liang and Han allied and deployed sharp weapons; Ba and Han descended with brave formations.

sentences.zh: 南通五嶺，北出力原；

translations.literal: South he reached the Five Ridges, north he sent force to the Yuan plains;
translations.idiomatic: South to the Five Ridges, north force to the plains;

sentences.zh: 東夷不怨，西戎卽序。

translations.literal: eastern Yi bore no complaint, western Rong was at once ordered.
translations.idiomatic: eastern Yi were not aggrieved, western Rong were ordered.

sentences.zh: 可謂上流千里，持戟百萬，天下之至貴，四海之所推也。

translations.literal: One may say: a thousand li of upper stream, a million halberds—the world's utmost honor, what the four seas push forward.
translations.idiomatic: One may say a thousand li of upper stream and a million halberds—the world's height, what the four seas advance.

sentences.zh: 今海水飛雲，昆山起燎，魏文悲樂推之歲，韓宣嘆成禮之日，陽臺之下，獨有冠蓋相趨；

translations.literal: Now sea-water flies in clouds, Kun mountain flames rise; Wei Wen grieved the year of willing elevation, Han Xuan sighed the day of completed rites—below Yang Terrace only caps and canopies hurried;
translations.idiomatic: Now sea clouds rise and Kun flames blaze; Wei Wen grieved willing elevation, Han Xuan sighed completed rites—below Yang Terrace only caps hurried;

sentences.zh: 夢水之傍，尚致車輿結轍。

translations.literal: by Dreaming Waters carriages still formed ruts in line.
translations.idiomatic: by Dream Waters wagons still lined the road.

sentences.zh: 麰麥兩穗，出於南平之邦；

translations.literal: Double ears on millet came from the domain of Nanping;
translations.idiomatic: Double ears on wheat came from Nanping;

sentences.zh: 甘露泥枝，降乎當陽之境。

translations.literal: sweet dew and mud-branched trees descended on the lands of Dangyang.
translations.idiomatic: sweet dew on mud branches descended at Dangyang.

sentences.zh: 野蠶自績，何謝歐絲；

translations.literal: Wild silkworms spun of themselves—why defer to Ou silk;
translations.idiomatic: Wild silkworms spun—why praise Ou silk;

sentences.zh: 閒田生稻，寧殊雨粟。

translations.literal: idle fields bore rice—how different from rain of grain?
translations.idiomatic: idle fields bore rice—no different from grain from rain.

sentences.zh: 莫非品物咸亨，是稱文明光大，豈可徽號不彰於彝典，明試不陳乎車服者哉！

translations.literal: All things surely prosperous, this is called bright culture's great light—how could emblems and titles fail to shine in the canon, bright testing fail to appear in chariot and robe!
translations.idiomatic: All things prospered—bright culture's radiance—how could titles fail in the canon and testing fail in chariot and robe!

sentences.zh: 昔晉、鄭入周，尚作卿士；

translations.literal: In antiquity Jin and Zheng entered Zhou and still served as chief ministers;
translations.idiomatic: In antiquity Jin and Zheng entered Zhou yet served as chief ministers;

sentences.zh: 蕭、曹佐漢，且居相國。

translations.literal: Xiao and Cao aided Han and yet held the chancellorship.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao and Cao aided Han yet held chancellorship.

sentences.zh: 宜崇茲盛禮，顯答羣望。

translations.literal: This splendid rite should be exalted to answer the multitude's hope.
translations.idiomatic: This splendid rite should be raised to answer the multitude's hopes.

sentences.zh: 恪等稽尋甲令，博詢惇史，謹再拜上，進位相國，總百揆，竹使符一，別准恒儀。

translations.literal: Ke and others examined the armor command, broadly consulted the trustworthy records, humbly bowed twice and advance you to Chancellor of State, overseeing the hundred offices, one tally of bamboo envoy, separately as perpetual ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Ke and others searched armor commands, consulted trustworthy records, bowed twice, and advance you to chancellor of state overseeing the hundred offices, with one bamboo tally as constant ritual.

sentences.zh: 杖金斧以剪逆暴，乘玉輅而定社稷。

translations.literal: Bearing the golden axe to cut down rebels, riding the jade chariot to settle altar and state.
translations.idiomatic: Bearing golden axe to cut rebels, riding jade chariot to settle state.

sentences.zh: 傍羅麗於日月，貞明合于天地。

translations.literal: Arrayed splendors beside sun and moon, upright brightness joined with heaven and earth.
translations.idiomatic: Splendors ranged beside sun and moon, brightness joined heaven and earth.

sentences.zh: 扶危翼治，豈不休哉！

translations.literal: Supporting peril and winging order—how could it not be glorious!
translations.idiomatic: Supporting peril and ordering rule—how could it not be glorious!

sentences.zh: 恪等不通大體，自昧伏奏以聞。

translations.literal: Ke and others do not comprehend the great body, themselves obscured in prostrating this memorial for hearing.
translations.idiomatic: Ke and others lack the great form and prostrate this memorial for hearing.

sentences.zh: 世祖令答曰：「數鍾陽九，時惟百六，鯨鯢未剪，寤寐痛心。

translations.literal: The Taizong ordered reply: "The count falls on yang nine, the time is the hundred six; whales and krakens not yet cut—sleepless in grief of heart.
translations.idiomatic: Taizong ordered reply: "Count falls on yang nine, time is hundred six; foes not yet cut—sleepless with grief.

sentences.zh: 周粵天官，秦稱相國，東至于海，西至于河，南次朱鳶，北漸玄塞。

translations.literal: Zhou called it the Celestial Offices, Qin called Chancellor of State—east to the sea, west to the river, south to Zhuque, north approaching the dark passes.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou named celestial offices, Qin chancellor of state—east to sea, west to river, south to Zhuque, north to dark passes.

sentences.zh: 率茲小宰，弘斯大德。

translations.literal: Leading these petty ministers, broadening this great virtue—
translations.idiomatic: Leading petty ministers, broadening great virtue—

sentences.zh: 將何用繼蹤曲阜，擬跡桓、文，終建一匡，肅其五拜。

translations.literal: what use to follow tracks of Qufu, trace Huan and Wen, finally erect one rectification, solemn in the five bows?
translations.idiomatic: what use follow Qufu, trace Huan and Wen, erect one rectification, solemn in five bows?

sentences.zh: 雖義屬隨時，事無虛紀，傳稱皆讓，《象》著鳴謙，瞻言前典，再懷哽恧。」

translations.literal: Though righteousness follows the time, affairs have no empty record; tradition says all yielded, the Image shows sounding modesty—gazing on former canon, again choked with shame."
translations.idiomatic: Though righteousness follows time, affairs are not empty; tradition says all yielded, the Image shows modesty—gazing on former canon, again ashamed."

sentences.zh: 十二月壬辰，以定州刺史蕭勃爲鎮南將軍、廣州刺史。

translations.literal: On renchen in the twelfth month Dingshan Inspector Xiao Bo was made General Who Secures the South and Guangzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen in the twelfth month Dingshan inspector Xiao Bo became General Who Secures the South and Guangzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 遣護軍將軍尹悅、巴州刺史王珣、定州刺史杜多安帥衆下武昌，助徐文盛。

translations.literal: Protector-General Yin Yue, Bazhou Inspector Wang Xun, Dingshan Inspector Du Duo'an led troops down to Wuchang to aid Xu Wensheng.
translations.idiomatic: Protector-General Yin Yue, Bazhou inspector Wang Xun, Dingshan inspector Du Duo'an led troops to Wuchang to aid Xu Wensheng.

sentences.zh: 大寶二年，世祖猶稱太清五年。

translations.literal: In year 2 of Dabao the Taizong still called it year 5 of Taiqing.
translations.idiomatic: In Dabao 2 Taizong still called it Taiqing 5.

sentences.zh: 二月己亥，魏遣使來聘。

translations.literal: On jihai in the second month Wei sent envoys on a friendly visit.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai in the second month Wei sent friendly envoys.

sentences.zh: 三月，侯景悉兵西上，會任約軍。

translations.literal: In the third month Hou Jing mustered all troops westward to join Ren Yue's army.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Hou Jing mustered all troops west to join Ren Yue.

sentences.zh: 四月丙午，景遣其將宋子仙、任約襲郢州，執刺史蕭方諸。

translations.literal: On bingwu in the fourth month Jing sent his generals Song Zixian and Ren Yue to raid Yingzhou and seized Inspector Fangzhu.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu in the fourth month Hou Jing sent generals Song Zixian and Ren Yue to raid Yingzhou and seized inspector Fangzhu.

sentences.zh: 戊申，徐文盛、陰子春等奔歸，王珣、尹悅、杜多安並降賊。

translations.literal: On wushen Xu Wensheng, Yin Zichun, and others fled back; Wang Xun, Yin Yue, and Du Duo'an all surrendered to the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Xu Wensheng and Yin Zichun fled back; Wang Xun, Yin Yue, and Du Duo'an all surrendered to the rebels.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，領軍將軍王僧辯帥衆屯巴陵。

translations.literal: On gengxu Leader of the Palace Gentlemen Wang Senbian led troops stationed at Baling.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Wang Senbian led troops stationed at Baling.

sentences.zh: 甲子，景進寇巴陵。

translations.literal: On jiazi Jing advanced to raid Baling.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Hou Jing advanced against Baling.

sentences.zh: 五月癸未，世祖遣游擊將軍胡僧祐、信州刺史陸法和帥衆下援巴陵。

translations.literal: On guiwei in the fifth month the Taizong sent Mobile Headquarters General Hu Senyou and Xinzhou Inspector Lu Fahuo leading troops downstream to aid Baling.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei in the fifth month Taizong sent Mobile Headquarters Hu Senyou and Xinzhou inspector Lu Fahuo downstream to aid Baling.

sentences.zh: 任約敗，景遂遁走。

translations.literal: Ren Yue was defeated and Jing then fled.
translations.idiomatic: Ren Yue was defeated and Hou Jing fled.

sentences.zh: 以王僧辯爲征東將軍、開府儀同三司、尚書令，胡僧祐爲領軍將軍，陸法和爲護軍將軍。

translations.literal: Wang Senbian was made General Who Conquers the East, Three Lords honors, Director of the Masters of Writing; Hu Senyou Leader of the Palace Gentlemen; Lu Fahuo Protector-General.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Senbian became General Who Conquers the East with Three Lords honors and director of Masters of Writing; Hu Senyou leader of palace gentlemen; Lu Fahuo protector-general.

sentences.zh: 仍令僧辯率衆軍追景，所至皆捷。

translations.literal: He still ordered Senbian to lead the massed armies in pursuit of Jing; wherever they reached they were victorious.
translations.idiomatic: He still ordered Senbian to pursue Hou Jing; everywhere they were victorious.

sentences.zh: 八月甲辰，僧辯下次湓城。

translations.literal: On jiachen in the eighth month Senbian descended to camp at Xunyang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen in the eighth month Senbian camped below Xunyang.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以鎮南將軍、湘州刺史蕭方矩爲中衛將軍。

translations.literal: On xinhai General Who Secures the South and Xiangzhou Inspector Xiao Fangju was made Central Guard General.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai General Who Secures the South and Xiangzhou inspector Xiao Fangju became Central Guard General.

sentences.zh: 司空、征南將軍、南平王恪進號征南大將軍。

translations.literal: Minister of Works, General Who Conquers the South, Prince of Nanping Ke had his title advanced to Grand General Who Conquers the South.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Works and General Who Conquers the South Prince Ke of Nanping was promoted to Grand General Who Conquers the South.

sentences.zh: 湘州刺史，餘如故。

translations.literal: Jingzhou Inspector, the rest unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: Jingzhou inspector, other posts unchanged.

sentences.zh: 九月己亥，以征東將軍、開府儀同三司、尚書令王僧辯爲江州刺史，餘如故。

translations.literal: On jihai in the ninth month General Who Conquers the East with Three Lords honors and Director Wang Senbian was made Jiangzhou Inspector, the rest unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai in the ninth month General Who Conquers the East Wang Senbian with Three Lords honors became Jiangzhou inspector, other posts unchanged.

sentences.zh: 盤盤國獻馴象。

translations.literal: Panpan state presented a tame elephant.
translations.idiomatic: Panpan presented a tame elephant.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛丑朔，有紫雲如車蓋，臨江陵城。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, day xinchou, the new moon—purple cloud like a chariot canopy hung over Jiangling city.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, new moon of the tenth winter month, purple cloud like a chariot canopy hung over Jiangling.

sentences.zh: 是月，太宗崩。

translations.literal: That month the Taizong died.
translations.idiomatic: That month Taizong died.

sentences.zh: 侍中、征東將軍、開府儀同三司、江州刺史、尚書令、長寧縣侯王僧辯等奉表曰：

translations.literal: Attendant, General Who Conquers the East, Three Lords honors, Jiangzhou Inspector, Director of the Masters of Writing, Marquis of Changning Wang Senbian and others submitted a memorial saying:
translations.idiomatic: Attendant, General Who Conquers the East, Jiangzhou inspector, director, Marquis of Changning Wang Senbian and others submitted a memorial:

sentences.zh: 衆軍薄伐，塗次九水，卽日獲臨城縣使人報稱：侯景弒逆皇帝，賊害太子，宗室在寇庭者，並罹禍酷。

translations.literal: The massed armies made thin war; halted at the Nine Waters—on that day they obtained a man from Lincheng county who reported: Hou Jing murdered the emperor by treason, harmed the crown prince, and all of the imperial clan in the bandit court suffered cruel disaster.
translations.idiomatic: The armies pressed the campaign, halted at Nine Waters—that day a Lincheng county messenger reported Hou Jing had murdered the emperor, harmed the crown prince, and kin in the rebel court suffered cruel death.

sentences.zh: 六軍慟哭，三辰改曜。

translations.literal: The six armies grieved and wept; the three luminaries changed their light.
translations.idiomatic: The six armies wept; the three luminaries changed.

sentences.zh: 哀我皇極，四海崩心。

translations.literal: Alas for our imperial pole—the four seas' hearts collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: Alas for our imperial pole—the four seas' hearts broke.

sentences.zh: 我大梁纂堯構緒，基商啓祚。

translations.literal: Our great Liang received Yao's succession and traced Shang's opening heritage.
translations.idiomatic: Our great Liang received Yao's succession and traced Shang's opening.

sentences.zh: 太祖文皇帝徇齊作聖，肇有六州。

translations.literal: Grand Ancestor the Literary Emperor followed Qi and became sage, beginning the six provinces.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Ancestor the Literary Emperor followed Qi, became sage, and opened the six provinces.

sentences.zh: 高祖武皇帝聰明神武，奄龕天下。

translations.literal: The Martial Emperor the Gaozu was bright, divine, and martial, embracing all under heaven in one sweep.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu the Martial Emperor was bright, divine, and martial and in one sweep embraced the realm.

sentences.zh: 依日月而和四時，履至尊而制六合。

translations.literal: Relying on sun and moon he harmonized the four seasons; treading the utmost honor he regulated the six harmonies.
translations.idiomatic: Relying on sun and moon he harmonized four seasons; treading utmost honor he regulated the six harmonies.

sentences.zh: 麗正居貞，大橫固祉。

translations.literal: Establishing the correct and dwelling in constancy, the great crossbeams secured fortune.
translations.idiomatic: Establishing correctness and dwelling in constancy, great fortune was secured.

sentences.zh: 四葉相系，三聖同基。

translations.literal: Four leaves linked in succession, three sages shared one foundation.
translations.idiomatic: Four reigns linked in succession, three sages one foundation.

sentences.zh: 蠢爾凶渠，遂憑天邑。

translations.literal: That vicious chief thus relied on the heavenly capital.
translations.idiomatic: That vicious chief held the heavenly capital.

sentences.zh: 閶闔受白登之辱，象魏致堯城之疑。

translations.literal: The Vermilion Gate received the shame of Baideng; the Elephant Tower brought the doubt of Yaocheng.
translations.idiomatic: The vermilion gate knew Baideng's shame; the elephant tower Yaocheng's doubt.

sentences.zh: 雲扆承華，一朝俱酷。

translations.literal: Cloud canopy and Chenghua—in one morning all suffered cruelty.
translations.idiomatic: Cloud canopy and Chenghua—in one morning all suffered cruel death.

sentences.zh: 金楨玉幹，莫不同冤。

translations.literal: Golden pillars and jade stems—all alike suffered the same wrong.
translations.idiomatic: Golden pillars and jade stems: none escaped the same injustice.

sentences.zh: 悠悠彼蒼，何其罔極！

translations.literal: O distant azure Heaven, how boundless your cruelty!
translations.idiomatic: O distant azure Heaven—how boundless your cruelty!

sentences.zh: 臣聞喪君有君，《春秋》之茂典；

translations.literal: I have heard that when a ruler dies there is yet a ruler—the splendid canon of the Spring and Autumn;
translations.idiomatic: I have heard that when a ruler dies, another must rule—the splendid canon of the Spring and Autumn Annals;

sentences.zh: 以德以長，先王之通訓。

translations.literal: to choose the virtuous and the elder is the universal teaching of former kings.
translations.idiomatic: to choose the virtuous and the elder is the universal teaching of the former kings.

sentences.zh: 少康則牧衆撫職，祀夏所以配天；

translations.literal: Shaokang gathered the people and steadied his office, and so sacrificing to Xia he matched Heaven;
translations.idiomatic: Shaokang gathered the people and steadied his charge, and by sacrificing to Xia he matched Heaven;

sentences.zh: 平王則居正東遷，宗周所以卜世。

translations.literal: King Ping dwelt in righteousness and moved east, and so the Zhou of the Ancestor divined its age.
translations.idiomatic: King Ping held to righteousness and moved east, and so the Ancestral Zhou divined its span of years.

sentences.zh: 漢光以能捕不道，故景歷重昌；

translations.literal: Guangwu of Han, for capturing the lawless, saw the Jing era bloom again;
translations.idiomatic: Han Guangwu, because he could seize the lawless, saw the Jing calendar flourish again;

sentences.zh: 中宗以不違羣議，故江東可立。

translations.literal: Zhongzong, for not defying the multitude's counsel, could be established in Jiangdong.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongzong, because he did not defy the assembly's counsel, could be enthroned in Jiangdong.

sentences.zh: 儔今考古，更無二謀。

translations.literal: Compared with antiquity today, there is no second plan.
translations.idiomatic: Measured against antiquity today, there is no second counsel.

sentences.zh: 伏惟陛下至孝通幽，英武靈斷，當七九之厄，而應千載之期；

translations.literal: I humbly consider that Your Majesty's utmost filial piety penetrates the hidden realms, your heroism and martial resolve are sharp and clear—you face the calamity of seven-nines yet answer the term of a thousand years;
translations.idiomatic: I humbly consider that Your Majesty's filial piety reaches into the unseen, your heroism and martial clarity are keen—you meet the calamity of seven-nines and answer the term of a thousand years;

sentences.zh: 啓殷憂之明，而居百王之會。

translations.literal: you open the brightness within deep sorrow and stand at the gathering of a hundred kings.
translations.idiomatic: you open light within deep sorrow and stand where a hundred kings meet.

sentences.zh: 取威定霸，嶮阻艱難，建社治兵，載循古道。

translations.literal: You take awe and fix hegemony through peril and hardship, raise altars and order armies, ever following the ancient Way.
translations.idiomatic: You take awe and fix hegemony through peril and hardship, raise altars and order armies, ever following the ancient Way.

sentences.zh: 家國之事，一至於斯。

translations.literal: Affairs of house and state have come to this.
translations.idiomatic: Affairs of house and state have come to this pass.

sentences.zh: 天祚大梁，必將有主。

translations.literal: Heaven's mandate to Great Liang surely must have a lord.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's mandate to Great Liang surely must have a lord.

sentences.zh: 軒轅得姓，存者二人；

translations.literal: When Xuanyuan received his surname, two survived;
translations.idiomatic: When Xuanyuan received his surname, only two survived;

sentences.zh: 高祖五王，代實居長。

translations.literal: among Gaozu's five princes, your generation truly holds the eldest.
translations.idiomatic: among Gaozu's five princes, your generation truly holds the eldest rank.

sentences.zh: 乘屈完而陳諸侯，拜子武而服大輅。

translations.literal: You ride the chariot as Qu Wan did to array the feudal lords, bow as Zi Wu did and receive the great carriage.
translations.idiomatic: You ride as Qu Wan did to array the feudal lords, bow as Zi Wu did and receive the great carriage.

sentences.zh: 功齊九有，道濟生民。

translations.literal: Your merit equals the Nine Domains, your Way succors the living people.
translations.idiomatic: Your merit equals the Nine Domains, your Way succors the living people.

sentences.zh: 非奉聖明，誰嗣下武！

translations.literal: Unless we serve the sacred and bright, who will succeed the martial below?
translations.idiomatic: Unless we serve the sacred and bright, who will succeed the martial below?

sentences.zh: 臣聞日月貞明，太陽不可以闕照；

translations.literal: I have heard that sun and moon stand in bright constancy—the great sun cannot long withhold its light;
translations.idiomatic: I have heard that sun and moon stand in bright constancy—the great sun cannot long withhold its light;

sentences.zh: 天地貞觀，乾道不可以久惕。

translations.literal: Heaven and earth stand in constant regard—the Way of Qian cannot long remain in caution.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven and earth stand in constant regard—the Way of Qian cannot long remain in caution.

sentences.zh: 黃屋左纛，本爲億兆而尊；

translations.literal: The yellow canopy and left banner-pole are honored for the hundred millions;
translations.idiomatic: The yellow canopy and left banner-pole are honored for the hundred millions;

sentences.zh: 鸞輅龍章，蓋以郊禋而貴。

translations.literal: the phoenix carriage and dragon insignia are held noble for suburban sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: the phoenix carriage and dragon insignia are held noble for suburban sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 寶器存乎至重，介石慎於易差。

translations.literal: The sacred vessel rests in utmost weight; stand firm as on a whetstone, cautious lest ease bring slip.
translations.idiomatic: The sacred vessel rests in utmost weight; stand firm as on a whetstone, cautious lest ease bring slip.

sentences.zh: 黔首豈可少選無君，宗祏豈可一日無主。

translations.literal: Can the black-haired people lack a lord for even a brief span? Can the altars of state lack a master for even one day?
translations.idiomatic: Can the black-haired people lack a lord for even a brief span? Can the altars of state lack a master for even one day?

sentences.zh: 伏願陛下掃地升中，柴天改物。

translations.literal: I humbly wish Your Majesty to sweep the earth and ascend Mount Zhong, burn offerings to Heaven and renew all things.
translations.idiomatic: I humbly wish Your Majesty to sweep the earth and ascend Mount Zhong, burn offerings to Heaven and renew all things.

sentences.zh: 事迫凶危，運鍾擾攘，蓋不勞宗正奉詔，博士擇時，南面卽可居尊，西向無所讓德。

translations.literal: Affairs press in grim peril, the age rings with turmoil—in this case one need not trouble the Director of the Imperial Clan to present the edict or the Erudites to choose the hour; facing south you may at once take the honored seat, with no virtue to yield to the west.
translations.idiomatic: Affairs press in grim peril, the age rings with turmoil—there is no need to trouble the Director of the Imperial Clan to present the edict or the Erudites to choose the hour; face south and take the honored seat at once, with no virtue to yield westward.

sentences.zh: 四方旣知有奉，八百始可同期。

translations.literal: When the four quarters know there is one to whom they may turn, only then can the eight hundred begin to join in one purpose.
translations.idiomatic: When the four quarters know there is one to whom they may turn, only then can the eight hundred begin to join in one purpose.

sentences.zh: 殘寇潛居，器藏社處，乾象旣傾，坤儀已覆。

translations.literal: The remnant rebels lurk hidden, regalia is buried at the altars—the sign of Qian has already tipped, the measure of Kun already overturned.
translations.idiomatic: The remnant rebels lurk hidden, regalia is buried at the altars—the sign of Qian has already tipped, the measure of Kun already overturned.

sentences.zh: 斬莽輗車，燒卓照市，廓清函夏，正爲塋陵，開雪宮圍，庶存鐘鼎，彼黍離離，伊何可言。

translations.literal: Cut down Wang Mang's cortege, burn Dong Zhuo and light the market, clear all within the passes and seas—rightly for the imperial tombs, break the snowed palace ring and preserve in hope the bells and tripods—yet that millet, swaying, swaying—what words can tell it?
translations.idiomatic: Strike down Wang Mang's funeral train, burn Dong Zhuo till the market glows, clear all within the passes and seas—for the imperial tombs, break the snowed palace ring and save what bells and tripods may remain—yet that millet, swaying, swaying—what can be said?

sentences.zh: 陛下繼明闡祚，卽宮舊楚。

translations.literal: Your Majesty continues the bright succession and opens the mandate, taking your palace in old Chu.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty continues the bright succession and opens the mandate, taking your palace in old Chu.

sentences.zh: 左廟右社之制，可以權宜；

translations.literal: The order of ancestral temple left and soil-altar right may be provisionally arranged;
translations.idiomatic: The order of ancestral temple left and soil-altar right may be provisionally arranged;

sentences.zh: 五禮六樂之容，歲時取備。

translations.literal: the forms of the five rites and six harmonies may be gathered season by season as they come due.
translations.idiomatic: the forms of the five rites and six harmonies may be gathered season by season as they come due.

sentences.zh: 金芝九莖，瓊茅三脊。

translations.literal: Golden fungus with nine stalks, jade-thatched grass with triple ridges.
translations.idiomatic: Golden fungus with nine stalks, jade-thatched grass with triple ridges.

sentences.zh: 要衛率職，尉候相望。

translations.literal: Key defenses discharge their duties, frontier posts face one another.
translations.idiomatic: Key defenses discharge their duties, frontier posts face one another.

sentences.zh: 坐廟堂以朝四夷，登靈台而望雲物，禪梁甫而封泰山，臨東濱而禮日觀。

translations.literal: Sit in the hall of state to receive the four barbarians, ascend the Spirit Terrace to observe cloud-signs, offer the feng on Mount Tai by way of Liangfu, stand on the eastern shore and worship at Mount Riguang.
translations.idiomatic: Sit in the hall of state to receive the four barbarians, ascend the Spirit Terrace to observe cloud-signs, offer the feng on Mount Tai by way of Liangfu, stand on the eastern shore and worship at Mount Riguang.

sentences.zh: 然後與三事大夫，更謀都鄙。

translations.literal: Then with the great ministers of the Three Offices, reconvene to plan capital and countryside.
translations.idiomatic: Then with the great ministers of the Three Offices, reconvene to plan capital and countryside.

sentences.zh: 左瀍右澗，夾雒可以爲居，抗殿疏龍，惟王可以在鎬，何必勤勤建業也哉。

translations.literal: With the Luo's left-bank Chan and right-bank Jian as bounds one may dwell, raise the hall and unfurl the dragon banner—only a king may abide in Hao; why need one toil endlessly at Jianye?
translations.idiomatic: With the Luo's left-bank Chan and right-bank Jian as bounds one may dwell, raise the hall and unfurl the dragon banner—only a king may abide in Hao; why need one toil endlessly at Jianye?

sentences.zh: 臣等不勝控款之至，謹拜表以聞。

translations.literal: We your subjects cannot contain our earnest plea—respectfully we bow and present this memorial for your hearing.
translations.idiomatic: We your subjects cannot contain our earnest plea—respectfully we bow and present this memorial for your hearing.

sentences.zh: 世祖奉諱，大臨三日，百官縞素。

translations.literal: The Shizu observed mourning taboo, presided over the great lying-in for three days, and all officials wore white hemp.
translations.idiomatic: The Shizu observed mourning taboo, presided over the great lying-in for three days, and all officials wore white hemp.

sentences.zh: 乃答曰：「孤以不德，天降之災，枕戈飲膽，扣心泣血。

translations.literal: He then replied: "I, lacking virtue, suffer Heaven's calamity; I sleep upon my spear and taste gall, beat my breast and weep blood.
translations.idiomatic: He then replied, "I, lacking virtue, suffer Heaven's calamity; I sleep upon my spear and taste gall, beat my breast and weep blood.

sentences.zh: 風樹之酷，萬始不追；

translations.literal: The cruelty of wind and tree—nothing can overtake what is gone;
translations.idiomatic: The cruelty of wind and tree—nothing can overtake what is gone;

sentences.zh: 霜露之哀，百憂總萃。

translations.literal: the grief of frost and dew—all hundred sorrows gather at once.
translations.idiomatic: the grief of frost and dew—all hundred sorrows gather at once.

sentences.zh: 甫聞伯升之禍，彌切仲謀之悲。

translations.literal: Just hearing of Bo Sheng's calamity deepens the grief I share with Zhongmou.
translations.idiomatic: Just hearing of Bo Sheng's calamity deepens the grief I share with Zhongmou.

sentences.zh: 若封豕旣殲，長蛇卽戮，方欲追延陵之逸軌，繼子臧之高讓，豈資秋亭之壇，安事繁陽之石。

translations.literal: If the great boar is already destroyed and the long snake soon slain, I would then follow Yanling's withdrawn track, emulate Zizang's lofty yield—how could I rely on Qiu Ting's altar, or trouble myself with Fanyang's stone?
translations.idiomatic: If the great boar is already destroyed and the long snake soon slain, I would then follow Yanling's withdrawn track, emulate Zizang's lofty yield—how could I rely on Qiu Ting's altar, or trouble myself with Fanyang's stone?

sentences.zh: 侯景，項籍也；

translations.literal: Hou Jing is Xiang Yu;
translations.idiomatic: Hou Jing is Xiang Yu;

sentences.zh: 蕭棟，殷辛也。

translations.literal: Xiao Dong is Yin Xin of Shang.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Dong is Yin Xin of Shang.

sentences.zh: 赤泉未賞，劉邦尚曰漢王；

translations.literal: Before Chiquan's reward, Liu Bang was still called King of Han;
translations.idiomatic: Before Chiquan's reward, Liu Bang was still called King of Han;

sentences.zh: 白旗弗懸，周發猶稱太子。

translations.literal: Before the white banners were raised, Fa of Zhou was still called crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: Before the white banners were raised, Fa of Zhou was still called crown prince.

sentences.zh: 飛龍之位，孰謂可躋；

translations.literal: The seat of the soaring dragon—who says one may leap to it?
translations.idiomatic: The seat of the soaring dragon—who says one may leap to it?

sentences.zh: 附鳳之徒，旣聞來議。

translations.literal: Those who would attach to the phoenix have already heard my intent.
translations.idiomatic: Those who would attach to the phoenix have already heard my intent.

sentences.zh: 羣公卿士，其諭孤之志，無忽！

translations.literal: Lords, ministers, and officers—take counsel with my resolve, and do not neglect it!"
translations.idiomatic: Lords, ministers, and officers—take counsel with my resolve, and do not neglect it!"

sentences.zh: 」司空南平王恪率宗室五十餘人，領軍將軍胡僧祐率羣僚二百餘人，江州別駕張佚率吏民三百餘人，並奉牋勸進。

translations.literal: Minister of Works Prince Ke of Nanping led more than fifty of the imperial clan, General of the Guards Hu Sengyou led more than two hundred officials, and Zhang Yi, acting governor of Jiangzhou, led more than three hundred clerks and people—all submitting memorials urging accession.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Works Prince Ke of Nanping led more than fifty of the imperial clan, General of the Guards Hu Sengyou led more than two hundred officials, and Zhang Yi, acting governor of Jiangzhou, led more than three hundred clerks and people—all submitting memorials urging accession.

sentences.zh: 世祖固讓。

translations.literal: The Shizu firmly declined.
translations.idiomatic: The Shizu firmly declined.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙亥，王僧辯又奉表曰：

translations.literal: On yihai in the eleventh month, Wang Senbian again submitted a memorial, saying:
translations.idiomatic: On yihai in the eleventh month, Wang Senbian again submitted a memorial, saying,

sentences.zh: 紫宸曠位，赤縣無主，百靈聳動，萬國回皇。

translations.literal: The Purple Forbidden stands empty of its seat, the Red Land has no lord—all hundred spirits tremble, ten thousand realms turn their faces to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: The Purple Forbidden Hall stands vacant, the Red Land has no lord—a hundred spirits quiver, ten thousand realms turn toward the throne.

sentences.zh: 雖醉醒相扶，同歸景亳，式歌且誦，總赴唐郊，猶懼陛下俯首潸然，讓德不嗣。

translations.literal: Though drunk and sober support one another homeward to Jing Bo, singing and chanting, all bound for Tang's suburbs—we still fear Your Majesty will bow your head in tears, your yielding virtue unaccepted as succession.
translations.idiomatic: Though drunk and sober lean on one another toward Jing Bo, singing and chanting, all bound for Tang's suburbs—we still fear Your Majesty will bow your head in tears and let yielding virtue go unheeded.

sentences.zh: 傳車在道，方慎宋昌之謀；

translations.literal: The relay-chariot is already on the road—we must heed Song Chang's counsel;
translations.idiomatic: The relay-chariot is already on the road—we must heed Song Chang's counsel;

sentences.zh: 法駕已陳，尚杜耿純之勸。

translations.literal: the imperial equipage is already arrayed—yet still we block Geng Chun's urging.
translations.idiomatic: the imperial equipage is already arrayed—yet still we block Geng Chun's urging.

sentences.zh: 岳牧翹首，天民累息。

translations.literal: Mountain lords and pasture chiefs crane their necks; the people of Heaven draw breath in hope.
translations.idiomatic: Mountain lords and pasture chiefs crane their necks; the people of Heaven draw breath in hope.

sentences.zh: 臣聞星回日薄，擊雷鞭電者之謂天；

translations.literal: I have heard that when stars wheel and the sun draws near, thunder is struck and lightning lashed—that is called Heaven;
translations.idiomatic: I have heard that when stars wheel and the sun draws near, thunder is struck and lightning lashed—that is called Heaven;

sentences.zh: 岳立川流，吐霧蒸雲者之謂地。

translations.literal: when peaks stand and rivers flow, mist is breathed and clouds steamed—that is called Earth.
translations.idiomatic: when peaks stand and rivers flow, mist is breathed and clouds steamed—that is called Earth.

sentences.zh: 苞天地之混成，洞陰陽之不測，而以裁成萬物者，其在聖人乎！

translations.literal: To embrace Heaven and Earth's blended completion, pierce yin and yang's unfathomable depth, and thereby trim and finish the ten thousand things—is this not the sage?
translations.idiomatic: To embrace Heaven and Earth's blended completion, pierce yin and yang's unfathomable depth, and thereby trim and finish the ten thousand things—is this not the sage?

sentences.zh: 故云「天地之大德曰生，聖人之大寶曰位。

translations.literal: Thus it is said, "Heaven and Earth's greatest virtue is life; the sage's greatest treasure is the throne.
translations.idiomatic: Thus it is said, "Heaven and Earth's greatest virtue is life; the sage's greatest treasure is the throne.

sentences.zh: 」黃屋廟堂之下，本非獲已而居；

translations.literal: "Beneath the yellow canopy in the temple hall one does not dwell by one's own wish;
translations.idiomatic: Beneath the yellow canopy in the temple hall one does not dwell by one's own wish;

sentences.zh: 明鏡四衢之樽，蓋由應物取訓。

translations.literal: the clear mirror and goblet at the four crossroads—in teaching, one responds to things as they come.
translations.idiomatic: the clear mirror and goblet at the four crossroads—in teaching, one responds to things as they come.

sentences.zh: 伏惟陛下稽古文思，英雄特達。

translations.literal: I humbly consider Your Majesty traces antiquity in literary thought, heroic and uniquely penetrating.
translations.idiomatic: I humbly consider Your Majesty traces antiquity in literary thought, heroic and uniquely penetrating.

sentences.zh: 比以周旦，則文王之子；

translations.literal: Compared with Duke of Zhou, you are King Wen's son;
translations.idiomatic: Compared with Duke of Zhou, you are King Wen's son;

sentences.zh: 方之放勛，則帝摯之季。

translations.literal: matched with Emperor Yao, you are Emperor Zhi's younger brother.
translations.idiomatic: matched with Emperor Yao, you are Emperor Zhi's younger brother.

sentences.zh: 千年旦暮，可不在斯。

translations.literal: A thousand years' dawn and dusk—can they lie elsewhere than here?
translations.idiomatic: A thousand years' dawn and dusk—can they lie elsewhere than here?

sentences.zh: 庭闕湮亡，鐘鼎淪覆，嗣膺景曆，非陛下而誰？

translations.literal: Court and gate are drowned in ruin, bells and tripods overturned—who but Your Majesty should receive the bright succession?
translations.idiomatic: Court and gate are drowned in ruin, bells and tripods overturned—who but Your Majesty should receive the bright succession?

sentences.zh: 豈可使赤眉更立盆子，隗囂託置高廟。

translations.literal: Can we allow the Red Eyebrows to set up Penzi again, or Wei Xiao to enthrone his choice in the High Temple?
translations.idiomatic: Can we allow the Red Eyebrows to set up Penzi again, or Wei Xiao to enthrone his choice in the High Temple?

sentences.zh: 陛下方復從容高讓，用執謙光。

translations.literal: Your Majesty would yet leisurely yield on high, clutching modest light.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty would yet leisurely yield on high, clutching modest light.

sentences.zh: 展其矯行偽書，誣罔正朔，見機而作，斷可識矣。

translations.literal: Display their crooked conduct and forged writs, mock the true calendar—the time to act is clear; the decision can be seen.
translations.idiomatic: Display their crooked conduct and forged writs, mock the true calendar—the time to act is clear; the decision can be seen.

sentences.zh: 匪疑何卜，無待蓍龜。

translations.literal: When doubt is gone, why divine? No need to wait on yarrow or tortoise.
translations.idiomatic: When doubt is gone, why divine? No need to wait on yarrow or tortoise.

sentences.zh: 日者，公卿失馭，禍纏霄極，侯景憑陵，姦臣互起，率戎伐穎，無處不然，勸明誅晉，側足皆爾。

translations.literal: Lately the high ministers lost the reins, calamity coiled about heaven's pole—Hou Jing overran all, treacherous ministers rose in turn; leading armies to strike Ying, nowhere was it otherwise; urging clear punishment of Jin, all stood on tiptoe likewise.
translations.idiomatic: Lately the high ministers lost the reins, calamity coiled about heaven's pole—Hou Jing overran all, treacherous ministers rose in turn; leading armies to strike Ying, nowhere was it otherwise; urging clear punishment of Jin, all stood on tiptoe likewise.

sentences.zh: 刁斗夜鳴，烽火相照。

translations.literal: At night the garrison-clappers sounded, beacon fires lit one another.
translations.idiomatic: At night the garrison-clappers sounded, beacon fires lit one another.

sentences.zh: 中朝人士，相顧銜悲；

translations.literal: Men of the central court looked upon one another, grief in their mouths;
translations.idiomatic: Men of the central court looked upon one another, grief in their mouths;

sentences.zh: 涼州義徒，東望殞涕，惵惵黔首，將欲安歸！

translations.literal: righteous followers from Liangzhou gazed east and shed tears to their death—the trembling common people, whither could they turn!
translations.idiomatic: righteous followers from Liangzhou gazed east and shed tears to their death—the trembling common people, whither could they turn!

sentences.zh: 陛下英略緯天，沉明內斷，橫劍泣血，枕戈嘗膽，農山圮下之策，金匱玉鼎之謀，莫不定算扆帷，決勝千里。

translations.literal: Your Majesty's heroic designs net the heavens, your deep clarity cuts within; you weep blood over a sword laid across your lap, taste gall upon the spear beside your pillow—plans of Nong Mountain and the crumbled mound, counsels from the golden casket and jade tripod—all settled behind the curtain, victory decided a thousand li away.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty's heroic designs span the heavens, your deep clarity cuts within; you weep blood with a sword across your lap, taste gall beside your pillow—plans of Nong Mountain and the crumbled mound, counsels from the golden casket and jade tripod—all settled behind the curtain, victory decided a thousand li away.

sentences.zh: 擊靈鼉之鼓，而建翠華之旗，驅六州之兵，而總九伯之伐，四方雖虞，一戰以霸。

translations.literal: You beat the spirit-croc's drum and raise the king's azure banner, drive the armies of six provinces and marshal the nine lords' campaign—though the four quarters still worried, one battle made you hegemon.
translations.idiomatic: You beat the spirit-croc's drum and raise the king's azure banner, drive the armies of six provinces and marshal the nine lords' campaign—though the four quarters still worried, one battle made you hegemon.

sentences.zh: 斬其鯨鯢，旣章大戮，何校滅耳，莫匪姦回，史不絕書，府無虛月。

translations.literal: You cut down their leviathans; great punishments were already proclaimed; ears cropped, necks bound in cangue—not one was not a traitor; the histories never stopped writing, the archives had no empty month.
translations.idiomatic: You cut down their leviathans; great punishments were already proclaimed; ears cropped, necks bound in cangue—not one was not a traitor; the histories never stopped writing, the archives had no empty month.

sentences.zh: 自洞庭安波，彭蠡底定，文昭武穆，芳若椒蘭，敵國降城，和如親戚，九服同謀，百道俱進，國恥家怨，計期就雪，社稷不墜，翽在聖明。

translations.literal: Since the waves of Dongting grew calm and Pengli was settled, civil brilliance and martial depth fragrant as pepper and orchid, enemy states lowered their walls in peace like kin, nine domains took counsel together, a hundred roads advanced as one—national shame and family grudge were reckoned to be whitened soon, the altars would not fall: all hung upon sacred brilliance.
translations.idiomatic: Since the waves of Dongting grew calm and Pengli was settled, civil brilliance and martial depth fragrant as pepper and orchid, enemy states lowered their walls in peace like kin, nine domains took counsel together, a hundred roads advanced as one—national shame and family grudge were reckoned to be whitened soon, the altars would not fall: all hung upon sacred brilliance.

sentences.zh: 今也何時，而申帝啓之避，凶危若此，方陳泰伯之辭。

translations.literal: What hour is this, yet you voice Di Qi's withdrawal; peril so grim, yet you set forth the Earl of Tai's words?
translations.idiomatic: What hour is this, yet you voice Di Qi's withdrawal; peril so grim, yet you set forth the Earl of Tai's words?

sentences.zh: 國有具臣，誰敢奉詔。

translations.literal: The state has its proper ministers—who dares accept an edict of delay?
translations.idiomatic: The state has its proper ministers—who dares accept an edict of delay?

sentences.zh: 天下者高祖之天下，陛下者萬國之歡心，萬國豈可無君，高祖豈可廢祀。

translations.literal: All under Heaven is Great Gaozu's Heaven; Your Majesty is the ten thousand realms' heart's joy—the realms cannot lack a lord, Gaozu cannot lack sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: All under Heaven is Great Gaozu's Heaven; Your Majesty is the ten thousand realms' heart's joy—the realms cannot lack a lord, Gaozu cannot lack sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 卽日五星夜聚，八風通吹，雲煙紛郁，日月光華，百官象物而動，軍政不戒而備。

translations.literal: That very night the five stars gathered; the eight winds blew through; clouds and mist welled thick, sun and moon shone with glory; the hundred offices moved as omens dictated, military affairs stood ready without rallying call.
translations.idiomatic: That very night the five stars gathered; the eight winds blew through; clouds and mist welled thick, sun and moon shone with glory; the hundred offices moved as omens dictated, military affairs stood ready without rallying call.

sentences.zh: 飛艫巨艦，竟水浮川；

translations.literal: Flying war-boats and great ships filled the waters and floated upon the streams;
translations.idiomatic: Flying war-boats and great ships filled the waters and floated upon the streams;

sentences.zh: 鐵馬銀鞍，陵山跨谷。

translations.literal: iron horses and silver saddles crossed mountains and spanned valleys.
translations.idiomatic: iron horses and silver saddles crossed mountains and spanned valleys.

sentences.zh: 英傑接踵，忠勇相顧，湛宗族以酬恩，焚妻子以報主。

translations.literal: heroes came one on another's heels, the loyal and brave looked to one another—some drowned their clans to repay grace, some burned wife and children to answer their lord.
translations.idiomatic: heroes came one on another's heels, the loyal and brave looked to one another—some drowned their clans to repay grace, some burned wife and children to answer their lord.

sentences.zh: 莫不覆盾銜威，提斧擊衆，風飛電耀、志滅凶醜。

translations.literal: None failed to turn shield and bear awe, lift axe and strike the mass—wind-flying, lightning-flashing, wills bent on extinguishing the vicious and ugly.
translations.idiomatic: None failed to turn shield and bear awe, lift axe and strike the mass—wind-flying, lightning-flashing, wills bent on extinguishing the vicious and ugly.

sentences.zh: 所待陛下昭告后土，虔奉上帝，廣發明詔，師出以名，五行夕返，六軍曉進，便當盡司寇之威，窮蚩尤之伐，執石趙而求璽，斬姚秦而取鍾，修掃塋陵，奉迎宗廟。

translations.literal: What awaits is only Your Majesty proclaiming to the earth below, reverently serving the Lord on High, broadly issuing a bright edict, taking the army forth with righteousness named—five elements returned by evening, six armies advancing at dawn—then one would fully wield the Minister of Crime's awe, pursue the War of Chiyu to its end, seize Shi Le of Zhao and demand the seal, cut down Yao Qin and take the bells, repair and sweep the imperial tombs, welcome home the ancestral temple.
translations.idiomatic: All that awaits is Your Majesty proclaiming to the earth below, reverently serving the Lord on High, broadly issuing a bright edict, taking the army forth in righteousness's name—five elements home by evening, six armies advancing at dawn—then fully wield the Minister of Crime's awe, pursue Chiyu's war to its end, seize Shi Le of Zhao and demand the seal, cut down Yao Qin and take the bells, repair and sweep the imperial tombs, welcome home the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 陛下豈得不仰存國計，俯從民請。

translations.literal: How can Your Majesty fail to look up and preserve the state's plan, bow down and follow the people's plea?
translations.idiomatic: How can Your Majesty fail to look up and preserve the state's plan, bow down and follow the people's plea?

sentences.zh: 漢宣嗣位之後，卽遣蒲類之軍；

translations.literal: After Emperor Xuan of Han succeeded, he at once sent the army to Lake Pulei;
translations.idiomatic: After Emperor Xuan of Han succeeded, he at once sent the army to Lake Pulei;

sentences.zh: 光武登極旣竟，始有長安之捷。

translations.literal: when Guangwu had finished ascending the pole, only then came victory at Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: when Guangwu had finished ascending the pole, only then came victory at Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 由此言之，不無前准。

translations.literal: Spoken thus, precedent is not lacking.
translations.idiomatic: Spoken thus, precedent is not lacking.

sentences.zh: 臣等或世受朝恩，或身荷重遇，同休等戚，自國刑家，苟有腹心，敢以死奪。

translations.literal: We your subjects have either received dynastic favor through generations or borne heavy kindness in person; we share fortune and disaster, from state to family—forfeit life if need be, we dare not hold back our hearts.
translations.idiomatic: We your subjects have either received dynastic favor through generations or borne heavy kindness in person; we share fortune and disaster, from state to family—forfeit life if need be, we dare not hold back our hearts.

sentences.zh: 不任慺慺之至，謹重奉表以聞。

translations.literal: Unable to bear our utmost earnestness, we respectfully present this memorial again for your hearing.
translations.idiomatic: Unable to bear our utmost earnestness, we respectfully present this memorial again for your hearing.

sentences.zh: 世祖答曰：「省示，復具一二。

translations.literal: The Shizu replied: "Your memorial is received; you have set it out point by point once more.
translations.idiomatic: The Shizu replied, "Your memorial is received; you have set it out point by point once more.

sentences.zh: 孤聞天生蒸民而樹之以君，所以對揚天休，司牧黔首。

translations.literal: I have heard that Heaven bore the teeming people and set a lord over them, to echo Heaven's favor and shepherd the black-haired masses.
translations.idiomatic: I have heard that Heaven bore the teeming people and set a lord over them, to echo Heaven's favor and shepherd the black-haired masses.

sentences.zh: 攝提、合雒以前，栗陸、驪連之外，書契不傳，無得稱也。

translations.literal: Before Sheti and Heluo, beyond Lulu and Lilian, written records were not handed down and none can be named.
translations.idiomatic: Before Sheti and Heluo, beyond Lulu and Lilian, no written records survive and none can be named.

sentences.zh: 自阪泉彰其武功，丹陵表其文德，有人民焉，有社稷焉，或歌謠所歸，或惟天所相。

translations.literal: From Banspring, where martial merit was shown, to Danling, where civil virtue was displayed, there have been peoples and altars—some to whom songs and hymns returned, some whom Heaven alone assisted.
translations.idiomatic: From Banspring's martial fame to Danling's civil grace there have been people and altars—some claimed by song, some chosen by Heaven alone.

sentences.zh: 孤遭家多難，大恥未雪，國賊則蚩尤弗剪，同姓則有扈不賓，臥而思之，坐以待旦，何以應寶曆，何以嗣龍圖。

translations.literal: I have met many family calamities; great shame is unavenged—the national foe Chiyou is not cut down, clan kin like Youhu will not submit; lying down I ponder it, sitting I await dawn—how could I answer the precious succession, how inherit the dragon chart?
translations.idiomatic: I have suffered many family troubles; great shame is unavenged—national foes remain uncut, clan kin still refuse allegiance; I lie awake and sit for dawn—how could I answer the sacred calendar, how inherit the dragon chart?

sentences.zh: 庶一戎旣定，罪人斯得，祀夏配天，方申來議也。

translations.literal: Perhaps when one campaign is settled and the guilty are taken, when Xia is honored and Heaven matched, the coming deliberation may then be raised.
translations.idiomatic: Only when war is ended, the guilty seized, and rites to Xia match Heaven may the coming deliberation be raised.

sentences.zh: 」是時巨寇尚存，未欲卽位，而四方表勸，前後相屬，乃下令曰：「《大壯》乘乾，《明夷》垂翼，璇度亟移，玉律屢徙，四岳頻遣勸進，九棘比者表聞。

translations.literal: " At that time great bandits still survived; he did not wish to take the throne immediately, but memorials urging succession arrived from all quarters in succession; he then issued an order saying: "Dazhuang rides Qian, Mingyi hangs its wings—the stellar degree shifts repeatedly, the jade pitch-pipes move again and again; the Four Peaks frequently sent urging memorials, and the nine ministers in turn presented their tables.
translations.idiomatic: " At that time great rebels still lived; he did not wish to ascend yet, but urging memorials came from every quarter; he then ordered, "Dazhuang rides Qian, Mingyi folds its wings—the heavens turn again and again, the jade pitch-pipes shift repeatedly; the Four Peaks repeatedly urged succession, and the nine ministers in succession presented their tables.

sentences.zh: 譙、沛未復，塋陵永遠，于居于處，寤寐疚懷，何心何顏，撫茲歸運。

translations.literal: Qiao and Pei are not recovered, the tombs lie far away—in dwelling and resting, waking and sleeping, guilt weighs on me; what heart, what face could I bring to embrace this returning fortune?
translations.idiomatic: Qiao and Pei are not recovered, the imperial tombs lie far away—in waking and sleeping guilt weighs on me; what heart, what face could embrace this returning fortune?

sentences.zh: 自今表奏，所由並斷，若有啓疏，可寫此令施行。

translations.literal: From now memorials and submissions shall all be cut off; if anyone presents a petition, this order may be copied and enforced.
translations.idiomatic: From now all memorials and submissions are cut off; if anyone presents a petition, copy this order and enforce it.

sentences.zh: 」是日，賊司空、東南道大行台劉神茂率儀同劉歸義、留異赴義，奉表請降。

translations.literal: " That day the rebel Minister of Works, Grand Commissioner of the Southeast Circuit Liu Shenmao, leading Yitong Liu Guiyi and Liu Yiyou who came over in righteousness, submitted a memorial requesting surrender.
translations.idiomatic: " That day rebel Minister of Works and Grand Commissioner of the Southeast Circuit Liu Shenmao, with Yitong Liu Guiyi and Liu Yiyou who came over in loyalty, submitted a memorial requesting surrender.

sentences.zh: 大寶三年，世祖猶稱太清六年。

translations.literal: In Dabao year 3 the Shizu still used the year count of Ta Qing year 6.
translations.idiomatic: In Dabao 3 the Shizu still reckoned by Ta Qing 6.

sentences.zh: 正月甲戌，世祖下令曰：「軍國多虞，戎旃未靜，青領雖熾，黔首宜安。

translations.literal: First month, day jiaxu—the Shizu issued an order: "The army and state face many troubles; war banners are not yet still; though rebellion burns, the black-headed people should be at peace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu in the first month the Shizu ordered, "Army and state face many troubles and war banners are not yet still; though turmoil burns, the common people should be at peace.

sentences.zh: 時惟星鳥，表年祥於東秩；

translations.literal: Now is the Star-Bird season, showing the year's auspice in the eastern order;
translations.idiomatic: Now is the Star-Bird season, showing the year's auspice in the eastern order;

sentences.zh: 春紀宿龍，歌歲取於南畯。

translations.literal: spring marks the Azure Dragon constellation, and the harvest song is taken from the southern fields;
translations.idiomatic: spring marks the Azure Dragon, and the harvest song is taken from the southern fields;

sentences.zh: 況三農務業，尚看夭桃敷水；

translations.literal: all the more when the three classes of farming are at work and young peaches still spread over the water;
translations.idiomatic: all the more when the three classes of farming are at work and young peaches still spread over the water;

sentences.zh: 四人有令，猶及落杏飛花。

translations.literal: the four classes have their ordinances, and fallen apricot blossoms still fly.
translations.idiomatic: the four classes have their ordinances, and fallen apricot blossoms still fly.

sentences.zh: 化俗移風，常在所急；

translations.literal: Transforming custom and shifting the wind—these are ever urgent;
translations.idiomatic: Transforming custom and shifting the wind—these are ever urgent;

sentences.zh: 勸耕且戰，彌須自許。

translations.literal: urging farming yet also fighting—this must be assured all the more.
translations.idiomatic: urging farming yet also fighting—this must be assured all the more.

sentences.zh: 豈直燕垂寒谷，積黍自溫，寧可墮此玄苗，坐飡紅粒，不植鷰頷，空候蟬鳴。

translations.literal: How could one merely let the swallow hang in a cold valley and warm oneself on piled millet—how could one let this dark seedling fall, sit eating red grain, plant no dragon-throat crop, and wait empty for the cicada's song?
translations.idiomatic: How could one merely hang like a swallow in a cold valley and warm oneself on piled grain—how could one let seedlings fall, sit eating stored grain, plant no summer crop, and wait empty for the cicada's song?

sentences.zh: 可悉深耕穊種，安堵復業，無棄民力，並分地利。

translations.literal: All should deeply plow and sow fine seed, settle in peace and resume their trades, waste no people's strength, and share the land's benefits.
translations.idiomatic: All should deeply plow and sow fine seed, settle in peace and resume their trades, waste no labor, and share the land's benefits.

sentences.zh: 班勒州郡，咸使遵承。

translations.literal: Let this be proclaimed to the provinces and commanderies, and all obey it.
translations.idiomatic: Let this be proclaimed to the provinces and commanderies, and all obey it.

sentences.zh: 」以智武將軍、南平內史王褒爲吏部尚書。

translations.literal: " Zhiwu General and Interior Administrator of Nanping Wang Bao was made Minister of the Masters of Writing for Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: " Zhiwu General and Nanping interior administrator Wang Bao was made Minister of the Masters of Writing for Personnel.

sentences.zh: 二月，王僧辯衆軍發自尋陽。

translations.literal: Second month—Wang Senbian's armies set out from Xunyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Wang Senbian's armies set out from Xunyang.

sentences.zh: 世祖馳檄告四方曰：

translations.literal: The Shizu sent a rapid proclamation to the four quarters, saying:
translations.idiomatic: The Shizu sent a rapid proclamation to the four quarters, saying:

sentences.zh: 夫剝極生災，乃及龍戰，師貞終吉，方制獖豕。

translations.literal: When stripping reaches its limit calamity is born, and dragon-battle follows; an army firm at last is auspicious, and then the boar is mastered.
translations.idiomatic: When stripping reaches its limit calamity is born and dragon-battle follows; an army firm at last is auspicious, and then the boar is mastered.

sentences.zh: 豈不以侵陽盪薄，源之者亂階；

translations.literal: Is it not that when yang is invaded and the balance shaken, the source of disorder arises?
translations.idiomatic: Is it not that when yang is invaded and the balance shaken, the source of disorder arises?

sentences.zh: 定龕艱難，成之者忠義。

translations.literal: And that settling the niche of hardship is accomplished by loyalty and righteousness?
translations.idiomatic: And that settling the niche of hardship is accomplished by loyalty and righteousness?

sentences.zh: 故羿、澆滅於前，莽、卓誅於後。

translations.literal: Thus Yi and Jiao were destroyed in earlier ages, Wang Mang and Dong Zhuo executed in later times.
translations.idiomatic: Thus Yi and Jiao were destroyed in earlier ages, Wang Mang and Dong Zhuo executed in later times.

sentences.zh: 是故使桓、文之勳，復興於周代；

translations.literal: Hence the achievements of Duke Huan and Duke Wen revived in the Zhou age;
translations.idiomatic: Hence the achievements of Duke Huan and Duke Wen revived in the Zhou age;

sentences.zh: 溫、陶之績，彌盛於金行。

translations.literal: and the merit of Wen and Tao flourished all the more in the Jin line.
translations.idiomatic: and the merit of Wen and Tao flourished all the more in the Jin line.

sentences.zh: 粵若梁興五十餘載，平壹宇內，德惠悠長，仁育蒼生，義征不服。

translations.literal: Mark how for fifty years and more since Liang arose it has unified the realm, virtue and grace long extended, nourishing the living with benevolence and punishing the unsubmissive with righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: Mark how for fifty years and more since Liang arose it unified the realm, virtue and grace long extended, nourishing the living with benevolence and punishing the unsubmissive with righteousness.

sentences.zh: 左伊右瀍，咸皆仰化；

translations.literal: From the Yi on the left to the Chan on the right, all looked up to its transforming power;
translations.idiomatic: From the Yi on the left to the Chan on the right, all looked up to its transforming power;

sentences.zh: 濁涇清渭，靡不向風。

translations.literal: muddy Jing and clear Wei—none failed to turn toward its wind.
translations.idiomatic: muddy Jing and clear Wei—none failed to turn toward its wind.

sentences.zh: 建翠鳳之旗，則六龍驤首；

translations.literal: Raise the kingfisher banner, and six dragons toss their heads;
translations.idiomatic: Raise the kingfisher banner, and six dragons toss their heads;

sentences.zh: 擊靈鼉之鼓，則百神警肅。

translations.literal: strike the spirit drums, and a hundred spirits stand alert.
translations.idiomatic: strike the spirit drums, and a hundred spirits stand alert.

sentences.zh: 風、牧、方、邵之賢，衛、霍、辛、趙之將，羽林黃頭之士，虎賁緹騎之夫，叱吒則風雲興起，鼓動則嵩、華倒拔。

translations.literal: Worthies like Feng and Mu, Fang and Shao; generals like Wei and Huo, Xin and Zhao; guards in feather cloaks and yellow caps, tiger garrison and brocade-courier men—at a shout wind and cloud rose; at a drumbeat Song and Hua were uprooted.
translations.idiomatic: Worthies like Feng and Mu, Fang and Shao; generals like Wei and Huo, Xin and Zhao; guards in feather cloaks and yellow caps, tiger garrison and brocade-courier men—at a shout wind and cloud rose; at a drumbeat Song and Hua were uprooted.

sentences.zh: 自桐柏以北，孤竹以南，碣石之前，流沙之後，延頸舉踵，交臂屈膝。

translations.literal: From Tongbai north to Gushu south, before Jieshi and beyond the shifting sands, necks stretched and heels lifted, arms crossed and knees bent.
translations.idiomatic: From Tongbai north to Gushu south, before Jieshi and beyond the shifting sands, necks stretched and heels lifted, arms crossed and knees bent.

sentences.zh: 胡人不敢牧馬，秦士不敢彎弓。

translations.literal: The Hu did not dare pasture horses; Qin men did not dare bend bows.
translations.idiomatic: The Hu did not dare pasture horses; Qin men did not dare bend bows.

sentences.zh: 葉和萬邦，平章百姓，十堯九舜，曷足云也。

translations.literal: Harmony reached ten thousand states; the hundred clans were ordered—ten Yao and nine Shun, how could words suffice?
translations.idiomatic: Harmony reached ten thousand states; the hundred clans were ordered—ten Yao and nine Shun, how could words suffice?

sentences.zh: 賊臣侯景，匈奴叛臣，鳴鏑餘噍。

translations.literal: The rebel minister Hou Jing, a turncoat Xiongnu, the last snarl of a whistling arrow.
translations.idiomatic: The rebel minister Hou Jing, a turncoat Xiongnu, the last snarl of a whistling arrow.

sentences.zh: 懸瓠空城，本非國寶，壽春畿要，賞不逾月。

translations.literal: Xuanguo was an empty city, never a national treasure; Shouchun a capital district—its reward did not last a month.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanguo was an empty city, never a national treasure; Shouchun a capital district—its reward did not last a month.

sentences.zh: 開海陵之倉，賑常平之米，檄九府之費，錫三官之錢，冒于貨賄，不知紀極。

translations.literal: He opened Hailing's granaries, dispensed Changping rice, drew on the nine treasuries' funds, bestowed the three offices' coin—greedy for bribes beyond all reckoning.
translations.idiomatic: He opened Hailing's granaries, dispensed Changping rice, drew on the nine treasuries' funds, bestowed the three offices' coin—greedy for bribes beyond all reckoning.

sentences.zh: 敢興逆亂，梗我王畿。

translations.literal: He dared to raise rebellion and block our royal domain.
translations.idiomatic: He dared to raise rebellion and block our royal domain.

sentences.zh: 賊臣正德，阻兵安忍。

translations.literal: The rebel minister Zhengde nourished troops and bore cruelty with ease.
translations.idiomatic: The rebel minister Zhengde nourished troops and bore cruelty with ease.

sentences.zh: 日者結怨江羋，遠適單于。

translations.literal: Lately he nursed grievance in the Yangtze marshes and fled far to the Xiongnu chieftain.
translations.idiomatic: Lately he nursed grievance in the Yangtze marshes and fled far to the Xiongnu chieftain.

sentences.zh: 簡牘屢彰，彭生之魂未弭；

translations.literal: His written pleas piled up, yet Peng Sheng's ghost was not stilled;
translations.idiomatic: His written pleas piled up, yet Peng Sheng's ghost was not stilled;

sentences.zh: 聚斂無度，景卿之誚已及。

translations.literal: his exactions knew no limit, and Jing Qing's reproach had already arrived.
translations.idiomatic: his exactions knew no limit, and Jing Qing's reproach had already arrived.

sentences.zh: 爲虎傅翼，遠相招致。

translations.literal: Giving a tiger wings, he summoned them from afar.
translations.idiomatic: Giving a tiger wings, he summoned them from afar.

sentences.zh: 虔劉我生民，離散我兄弟。

translations.literal: He slaughtered our living people and scattered our kin.
translations.idiomatic: He slaughtered our living people and scattered our kin.

sentences.zh: 我是以董率皋貔，躬擐甲胄，霜戈照日，則晨離奪暉，龍騎蔽野，則平原掩色，信與江水同流，氣與寒風俱憤。

translations.literal: Therefore I led the strike-force, buckled on armor myself; when frost-bright spears lit the sun, the morning light lost its gleam; when dragon cavalry blanketed the plain, the fields lost their color—my faith flowed with the river, my wrath rode with the cold wind.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore I led the strike-force and buckled on armor myself; when frost-bright spears lit the sun, morning light lost its gleam; when dragon cavalry blanketed the plain, the fields lost their color—my faith flowed with the river, my wrath rode with the cold wind.

sentences.zh: 凶醜畏威，委命下吏，乞活淮、肥，苟存徐、兗。

translations.literal: The foul enemy feared force and surrendered to low officials, begging life between Huai and Fei, clinging to existence in Xu and Yan.
translations.idiomatic: The foul enemy feared force and surrendered to low officials, begging life between Huai and Fei, clinging to existence in Xu and Yan.

sentences.zh: 渙汗旣行，絲綸爰被。

translations.literal: The imperial grace was announced, the silken edicts spread abroad.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial grace was announced, the silken edicts spread abroad.

sentences.zh: 我是以班師凱歸，休牛息馬。

translations.literal: Therefore I withdrew the army in victory and let oxen and horses rest.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore I withdrew the army in victory and let oxen and horses rest.

sentences.zh: 賊猶不悛。

translations.literal: The bandit still did not repent.
translations.idiomatic: The bandit still did not repent.

sentences.zh: 遂復矢流王屋，兵躔象魏。

translations.literal: Again arrows flew at the Royal House; troops pressed the Elephant Gate.
translations.idiomatic: Again arrows flew at the Royal House; troops pressed the Elephant Gate.

sentences.zh: 總章之觀，非復聽訟之堂；

translations.literal: The Zongzhang observatory was no longer the hall for hearing suits;
translations.idiomatic: The Zongzhang observatory was no longer the hall for hearing suits;

sentences.zh: 甘泉之宮，永乖避暑之地。

translations.literal: the Ganquan palace forever lost its place of summer refuge.
translations.idiomatic: the Ganquan palace forever lost its place of summer refuge.

sentences.zh: 坐召憲司，臥制朝宰，矯託天命，偽作符書。

translations.literal: Sitting he summoned the judiciary; lying down he directed the chief ministers—counterfeiting Heaven's mandate, forging talisman writings.
translations.idiomatic: Sitting he summoned the judiciary; lying down he directed the chief ministers—counterfeiting Heaven's mandate, forging talisman writings.

sentences.zh: 重增賦斂，肆意裒剝，生者逃竄，死者暴尸，道路以目，庶僚鉗口。

translations.literal: He doubled levies and stripped at will; the living fled, the dead lay exposed in the roads; men dared only look with their eyes, officials kept their mouths shut.
translations.idiomatic: He doubled levies and stripped at will; the living fled, the dead lay exposed in the roads; men dared only look with their eyes, officials kept their mouths shut.

sentences.zh: 刑戮失衷，爵賞由心，老弱波流，士女塗炭。

translations.literal: Punishment lost its measure; ranks and rewards followed his whim; old and weak were swept like waves, gentlemen and women charred like coals.
translations.idiomatic: Punishment lost its measure; ranks and rewards followed his whim; old and weak were swept like waves, gentlemen and women charred like coals.

sentences.zh: 臧獲之人，五宗及賞；

translations.literal: Menials won rewards reaching five generations;
translations.idiomatic: Menials won rewards reaching five generations;

sentences.zh: 搢紳之士，三族見誅。

translations.literal: gentry were punished to the third degree.
translations.idiomatic: gentry were punished to the third degree.

sentences.zh: 榖粟騰踴，自相吞噬。

translations.literal: Grain soared in price; people devoured one another.
translations.idiomatic: Grain soared in price; people devoured one another.

sentences.zh: 惵惵黔首，路有銜索之哀；
