translations.literal: The trembling black-headed people—wept on the roads as if led to the gallows;
translations.idiomatic: The trembling black-headed people—wept on the roads as if led to the gallows;

sentences.zh: 蠢蠢黎民，家隕桓山之泣。

translations.literal: the numbed common folk—each household mourned like at Mount Huan.
translations.idiomatic: the numbed common folk—each household mourned like at Mount Huan.

sentences.zh: 偃師南望，無復儲胥、露寒，河陽北臨，或有穹廬氈帳。

translations.literal: Looking south from Yanshi, no more Palace Storehouse or Cold Dew; gazing north from Heyang, perhaps only felt tents of the steppe.
translations.idiomatic: Looking south from Yanshi, no more Palace Storehouse or Cold Dew; gazing north from Heyang, perhaps only felt tents of the steppe.

sentences.zh: 南山之竹，未足言其愆；

translations.literal: Bamboo of the southern mountains cannot suffice to record his crimes;
translations.idiomatic: Bamboo of the southern mountains cannot suffice to record his crimes;

sentences.zh: 西山之兔，不足書其罪。

translations.literal: rabbits of the western hills cannot supply ink enough for his guilt.
translations.idiomatic: rabbits of the western hills cannot supply ink enough for his guilt.

sentences.zh: 外監陳瑩之至，伏承先帝登遐，宮車晏駕。

translations.literal: When Outer Supervisor Chen Ying arrived, I learned with bowed head that the late emperor had ascended afar and the palace carriage had halted at dusk.
translations.idiomatic: When Outer Supervisor Chen Ying arrived, I learned with bowed head that the late emperor had ascended afar and the palace carriage had halted at dusk.

sentences.zh: 奉諱驚號，五內摧裂，州冤本毒，無地容身。

translations.literal: Receiving the tabooed tidings I cried out in shock; my five viscera tore apart—grief rooted in the provinces, poison in the bone—nowhere to set my body.
translations.idiomatic: Receiving the tabooed tidings I cried out in shock; my five viscera tore apart—grief rooted in the provinces, poison in the bone—nowhere to set my body.

sentences.zh: 景阻饑旣甚，民且狼顧，遂侵軼我彭蠡，憑凌我郢邑，窮據我江夏，掩襲我巴丘。

translations.literal: Jing's blockade and famine were extreme; the people looked back like wolves; he then overran our Poyang, towered over our Ying capital, seized our Jiangxia to the limit, and stormed our Baqiu.
translations.idiomatic: Jing's blockade and famine were extreme; the people looked back like wolves; he then overran our Poyang, towered over our Ying capital, seized our Jiangxia to the limit, and stormed our Baqiu.

sentences.zh: 我是以義勇爭先，忠貞儘力。

translations.literal: Therefore the righteous vied to lead and the loyal gave all their strength.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore the righteous vied to lead and the loyal gave all their strength.

sentences.zh: 斬馘凶渠，不可稱算，沙同赤岸，水若絳河。

translations.literal: The slain chieftains cannot be counted; sand like the Red Bank, water like the Crimson River.
translations.idiomatic: The slain chieftains cannot be counted; sand like the Red Bank, water like the Crimson River.

sentences.zh: 任約泥首於安南，化仁面縛於漢口，子仙乞活於鄢郢，希榮敗績於柴桑。

translations.literal: Ren Yue bowed with muddy head at Annan; Hua Ren came bound at Hankou; Zi Xian begged life at Yan and Ying; Xi Rong was routed at Chaisang.
translations.idiomatic: Ren Yue bowed with muddy head at Annan; Hua Ren came bound at Hankou; Zi Xian begged life at Yan and Ying; Xi Rong was routed at Chaisang.

sentences.zh: 侯景奔竄，十鼠爭穴，郭默清夷，晉熙附義，計窮力屈，反殺後主。

translations.literal: Hou Jing fled in panic—ten rats fighting for one hole; Guo Mo was pacified, Jinxi came over in righteousness; when plots were spent and strength broken, he turned and killed the late sovereign.
translations.idiomatic: Hou Jing fled in panic—ten rats fighting for one hole; Guo Mo was pacified, Jinxi came over in righteousness; when plots were spent and strength broken, he turned and killed the late sovereign.

sentences.zh: 畢、原、禜、郇、並離禍患，凡、蔣、邢、茅，皆伏鈇鑕。

translations.literal: Bi, Yuan, Yu, and Xun—all suffered calamity; Fan, Jiang, Xing, and Mao—all bowed to the axe.
translations.idiomatic: Bi, Yuan, Yu, and Xun—all suffered calamity; Fan, Jiang, Xing, and Mao—all bowed to the axe.

sentences.zh: 是可忍也，孰不可容！

translations.literal: If this can be borne, what cannot be endured!
translations.idiomatic: If this can be borne, what cannot be endured!

sentences.zh: 幕府據有上流，實惟分陝，投袂荷戈、志在畢命。

translations.literal: The headquarters holds the upper stream, truly the covenant of Fen and Shan—sleeves thrown back, halberds shouldered, resolve set on giving the last breath.
translations.idiomatic: The headquarters holds the upper stream, truly the covenant of Fen and Shan—sleeves thrown back, halberds shouldered, resolve set on giving the last breath.

sentences.zh: 昔周依晉、鄭，漢有虛、牟。

translations.literal: Long ago Zhou relied on Jin and Zheng; Han had Xu and Mou.
translations.idiomatic: Long ago Zhou relied on Jin and Zheng; Han had Xu and Mou.

sentences.zh: 彼惟末屬，猶能如此；

translations.literal: They were but distant branches, yet could do as much;
translations.idiomatic: They were but distant branches, yet could do as much;

sentences.zh: 況聯華日月，天下不賤，爲臣爲子，兼國兼家者哉！

translations.literal: how much more we who share the glory of sun and moon—no one in the realm is base—both minister and son, with state and clan together!
translations.idiomatic: how much more we who share the glory of sun and moon—no one in the realm is base—both minister and son, with state and clan together!

sentences.zh: 咸以義旗旣建，宜須總一，共推幕府，實用主盟。

translations.literal: All agree that since the banner of righteousness is raised, unity is needed; we jointly uphold the headquarters as true arbiter.
translations.idiomatic: All agree that since the banner of righteousness is raised, unity is needed; we jointly uphold the headquarters as true arbiter.

sentences.zh: 粵以不佞，謬董連率，遠惟國艱，不遑寧處。

translations.literal: I, unworthy, am wrongly set as commander-in-chief; viewing the state's hardship from afar, I have no leisure to rest.
translations.idiomatic: I, unworthy, am wrongly set as commander-in-chief; viewing the state's hardship from afar, I have no leisure to rest.

sentences.zh: 中權後勁，龔行天罰，提戈蒙險，隕越以之。

translations.literal: The center holds authority, the rear supplies strength; we march with Heaven's punishment, lift spears through peril, and risk our lives in the doing.
translations.idiomatic: The center holds authority, the rear supplies strength; we march with Heaven's punishment, lift spears through peril, and risk our lives in the doing.

sentences.zh: 天馬千羣，長戟百萬，驅賁獲之士，資智勇之力，大楚逾荊山，淺原度彭蠡，舳艫泛水，以掎其南，輜軿委輸，以沖其北。

translations.literal: A thousand heavenly horses, a million long halberds—we drive warriors like Ben and Huo, draw on wisdom and courage; great Chu crosses Mount Jing, shallow plains ford Poyang; war-boats spread over the waters to pin the south, supply carts pour in to strike the north.
translations.idiomatic: A thousand heavenly horses, a million long halberds—we drive warriors like Ben and Huo, draw on wisdom and courage; great Chu crosses Mount Jing, shallow plains ford Poyang; war-boats spread over the waters to pin the south, supply carts pour in to strike the north.

sentences.zh: 華夷百濮，贏糧影從。

translations.literal: Hua and Yi, the hundred Pu—carry grain and follow like shadows.
translations.idiomatic: Hua and Yi, the hundred Pu—carry grain and follow like shadows.

sentences.zh: 雷震風駭，直指建業。

translations.literal: Thunder shakes and wind storms; we aim straight for Jianye.
translations.idiomatic: Thunder shakes and wind storms; we aim straight for Jianye.

sentences.zh: 按劍而叱，江水爲之倒流；

translations.literal: Draw the sword and shout—the river rolls backward;
translations.idiomatic: Draw the sword and shout—the river rolls backward;

sentences.zh: 抽戈而揮，皎日爲之退舍。

translations.literal: fling out the spear—the bright sun steps aside.
translations.idiomatic: fling out the spear—the bright sun steps aside.

sentences.zh: 方駕長驅，百道俱入，夷山殄谷，充原蔽野。

translations.literal: We race chariots in long advance; a hundred roads enter together; mountains are leveled, valleys filled—the plain is covered.
translations.idiomatic: We race chariots in long advance; a hundred roads enter together; mountains are leveled, valleys filled—the plain is covered.

sentences.zh: 挾輈曳牛之侶，拔距磔石之夫，騎則逐日追風，弓則吟猿落雁。

translations.literal: Men who yoke chariots and drag oxen, men who leap and shatter stone—on horseback they chase sun and wind; with bows they drop crying apes and falling geese.
translations.idiomatic: Men who yoke chariots and drag oxen, men who leap and shatter stone—on horseback they chase sun and wind; with bows they drop crying apes and falling geese.

sentences.zh: 捧崑崙而壓卵，傾渤海而灌熒。

translations.literal: They could hold Kunlun and crush an egg, tip Bohai and flood a lamp.
translations.idiomatic: They could hold Kunlun and crush an egg, tip Bohai and flood a lamp.

sentences.zh: 如駟馬之載鴻毛，若奔牛之觸魯縞。

translations.literal: Like four horses bearing a swan's down, like a running ox brushing Lu silk.
translations.idiomatic: Like four horses bearing a swan's down, like a running ox brushing Lu silk.

sentences.zh: 以此衆戰，誰能御之！

translations.literal: With such a host to fight—who could withstand it!
translations.idiomatic: With such a host to fight—who could withstand it!

sentences.zh: 脫復蜂蠆有毒，獸窮則鬬。

translations.literal: Even if bees and scorpions still had venom, beasts cornered would still fight—
translations.idiomatic: Even if bees and scorpions still had venom, beasts cornered would still fight—

sentences.zh: 謂山蓋高，則四郊多壘；

translations.literal: say the mountain is high, and ramparts ring the four suburbs;
translations.idiomatic: say the mountain is high, and ramparts ring the four suburbs;

sentences.zh: 謂地蓋遠，則三千弗違。

translations.literal: say the earth is vast, and none of three thousand leagues would stay away.
translations.idiomatic: say the earth is vast, and none of three thousand leagues would stay away.

sentences.zh: 如彼怒蛙，譬如鼷鼠，豈費萬鈞，無勞百溢。

translations.literal: Like that angry frog, like that harvest mouse—what need of ten thousand jun, what labor of a hundred yin?
translations.idiomatic: Like that angry frog, like that harvest mouse—what need of ten thousand jun, what labor of a hundred yin?

sentences.zh: 加以日臨黃道，兵起絳宮，三門旣啓，五將咸發，舉整整之旗，掃亭亭之氣，故以臨機密運，非賊所解，奉義而誅，何罪不服？

translations.literal: Add that the sun stands on the Yellow Way, troops rise in the Scarlet Palace; the three gates are open, five generals all deploy; we raise the banners of order and sweep the vapors of ill omen—thus we move in close concert at the moment of battle, beyond what rebels understand; punish in righteousness—what guilt would not submit?
translations.idiomatic: Add that the sun stands on the Yellow Way, troops rise in the Scarlet Palace; the three gates are open, five generals all deploy; we raise the banners of order and sweep the vapors of ill omen—thus we move in close concert at the moment of battle, beyond what rebels understand; punish in righteousness—what guilt would not submit?

sentences.zh: 今遣使持節、大都督、征東將軍、開府儀同三司、江州刺史、尚書令、長寧縣開國侯王僧辯率衆十萬，直掃金陵。

translations.literal: Now I send the Bearer of Credentials, Grand Commander, General Who Conquers the East, Commissioner with rites equal to the Three Excellencies, Jiangzhou Inspector, Director of the Masters of Writing, Marquis of Changning Wang Senbian leading a host of one hundred thousand to sweep Jinling directly.
translations.idiomatic: Now I send Bearer of Credentials, Grand Commander, General Who Conquers the East, Commissioner with rites equal to the Three Excellencies, Jiangzhou inspector, Director of the Masters of Writing, Marquis of Changning Wang Senbian leading one hundred thousand men to sweep Jinling directly.

sentences.zh: 鳴鼓聒天，摐金振地。

translations.literal: Drums deafen heaven; gongs shake the earth.
translations.idiomatic: Drums deafen heaven; gongs shake the earth.

sentences.zh: 朱旗夕建，如赤城之霞起；

translations.literal: Crimson banners rise at dusk like dawn-clouds over Redwall;
translations.idiomatic: Crimson banners rise at dusk like dawn-clouds over Redwall;

sentences.zh: 戈船夜動，若滄海之奔流。

translations.literal: War boats moved at night like a sea in full flood.
translations.idiomatic: At night the war boats stirred like the ocean rushing in flood.

sentences.zh: 計其同惡，不盈一旅。

translations.literal: Count their fellow villains—they do not fill one brigade.
translations.idiomatic: Counting their accomplices, they scarcely make a single brigade.

sentences.zh: 君子在野，小人比周。

translations.literal: The gentleman stands apart in the wilds; petty men huddle in factions.
translations.idiomatic: The gentleman is in the wilds; petty men band together.

sentences.zh: 何校滅耳，匪朝伊夕。

translations.literal: His fetters will be struck away—not a matter of one morning or one evening.
translations.idiomatic: The shackles will come off his ears—not a question of tomorrow or the day after.

sentences.zh: 舂長狄之喉，系郅支之頸。

translations.literal: We shall pound the throat of the Long Di and bind the neck of Zhizhi.
translations.idiomatic: We will crush the Long Di's throat and tie the neck of Zhizhi.

sentences.zh: 今司寇明罰，質釒夫所誅，止侯景而已。

translations.literal: Now the Minister of Crime clarifies punishment; the execution block awaits—only Hou Jing need be put to death.
translations.idiomatic: Now the minister of crime has made the penalty clear; the block awaits—only Hou Jing is to be executed.

sentences.zh: 黎元何辜，一無所問。

translations.literal: What crime have the common people? None shall be questioned.
translations.idiomatic: What guilt have the black-headed people? None will be questioned.

sentences.zh: 諸君或世樹忠貞，身荷寵爵，羽儀鼎族，書勳王府，俯眉猾豎，無由自效，豈不下慚泉壤，上愧皇天！

translations.literal: You gentlemen may for generations have planted loyalty, borne favor and rank on your shoulders, stood as feathered ornaments of great clans, and had your deeds written in the royal house—yet bowing to that knave you could not serve; can you not feel shame before the yellow springs below and before Heaven above!
translations.idiomatic: Some of you have borne loyalty for generations, carried favor and rank, stood among the great clans, and had your deeds recorded in the royal house—yet you bowed to that knave and could not serve. Are you not ashamed before the dead below and Heaven above!

sentences.zh: 失忠與義，難以自立。

translations.literal: Without loyalty and righteousness one cannot stand alone.
translations.idiomatic: Lose loyalty and righteousness and you cannot stand on your own.

sentences.zh: 想誠南風，乃眷西顧，因變立功，轉禍爲福。

translations.literal: Trust in the southern wind, turn your gaze westward, turn change into merit and disaster into fortune.
translations.idiomatic: Trust the southern wind, look west again, turn change into merit and misfortune into blessing.

sentences.zh: 有能縛侯景及送首者，封萬戶開國公，絹布五萬匹。

translations.literal: Whoever binds Hou Jing and sends his head shall be enfeoffed as Duke with a fief of ten thousand households and receive fifty thousand bolts of silk and cloth.
translations.idiomatic: Whoever captures Hou Jing and delivers his head shall receive a fief of ten thousand households as founding duke and fifty thousand bolts of silk and cloth.

sentences.zh: 有能率動義衆，以應官軍，保全城邑，不爲賊用，上賞方伯，下賞剖符，並裂山河，以紆青紫。

translations.literal: Whoever can rouse righteous hosts to answer the imperial armies, hold cities and not serve the rebels—the highest reward is that of a regional lord, the lowest a split tally; all may receive fiefs and the blue-and-purple sash.
translations.idiomatic: Whoever can rally righteous forces to join the imperial armies, hold cities and refuse the rebels—the highest reward is that of a regional lord, the lowest a split tally; all may receive fiefs and the purple sash.

sentences.zh: 昔由余入秦，禮同卿佐；

translations.literal: In old times You Yu entered Qin and was treated like a chief minister;
translations.idiomatic: Long ago You Yu entered Qin and was honored like a chief minister;

sentences.zh: 日磾降漢，且珥金貂。

translations.literal: Rizhu submitted to Han and still wore the golden sable.
translations.idiomatic: Jin Midi surrendered to Han and still wore the golden sable.

sentences.zh: 必有其才，何卹無位。

translations.literal: If a man has talent, why worry that he lacks a post?
translations.idiomatic: If there is talent, why fear there is no office?

sentences.zh: 若執迷不反，拒逆王師，大軍一臨，刑茲罔赦。

translations.literal: If you cling to delusion and will not turn back, resisting the royal armies—when the great host arrives, punishment will know no pardon.
translations.idiomatic: If you persist in delusion and resist the royal armies, when the great host arrives punishment will know no pardon.

sentences.zh: 孟諸焚燎，芝艾俱盡；

translations.literal: When Mengzhu burned, mugwort and artemisia perished together;
translations.idiomatic: When Mengzhu burned, mugwort and artemisia were consumed together;

sentences.zh: 宣房河決，玉石同沉。

translations.literal: when the Xuanfang River burst, jade and common stone sank as one.
translations.idiomatic: when the Xuanfang River broke, jade and stone sank together.

sentences.zh: 信賞之科，有如皎日；

translations.literal: The statute of faithful reward is bright as the noon sun;
translations.idiomatic: The statute of faithful reward is bright as the noonday sun;

sentences.zh: 黜陟之制，事均白水。

translations.literal: the rule of demotion and promotion is equal to the clarity of Baishui.
translations.idiomatic: the rule of demotion and promotion matches the clarity of Baishui.

sentences.zh: 檄布遠近，咸使知聞。

translations.literal: Let this proclamation be sent far and near so that all may know.
translations.idiomatic: Let this proclamation go far and near so all may know.

sentences.zh: 三月，王僧辯等平侯景，傳其首于江陵。

translations.literal: In the third month Wang Sengbian and others pacified Hou Jing and sent his head to Jiangling.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Wang Sengbian and others destroyed Hou Jing and forwarded his head to Jiangling.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以賊平告明堂、太社。

translations.literal: On wuzi the victory over the rebels was reported to the Bright Hall and the Grand Soil altar.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day the victory over the rebels was reported to the Bright Hall and the Grand Soil altar.

sentences.zh: 己丑，王僧辯等又奉表曰：

translations.literal: On jichou Wang Sengbian and others again submitted a memorial, saying:
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Wang Sengbian and others again submitted a memorial, saying,

sentences.zh: 衆軍以今月戊子總集建康。

translations.literal: The armies on this day, wuzi, assembled at Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: The armies assembled at Jiankang on this day, wuzi.

sentences.zh: 賊景鳥伏獸窮，頻擊頻挫，姦竭詐盡，深溝自固。

translations.literal: The rebel Jing, like a bird in a hole or a beast at bay, was struck again and again; his treachery and deceit were exhausted, and he dug deep trenches to hold fast.
translations.idiomatic: The rebel Jing, bird crouched and beast cornered, was struck again and again; treachery and deceit exhausted, he dug deep trenches to hold out.

sentences.zh: 臣等分勒武旅，百道同趣，突騎短兵，犀函鐵楯，結隊千羣，持戟百萬，止紂七步，圍項三重，轟然大潰，羣凶四滅。

translations.literal: Your servants divided and led the martial hosts; a hundred roads converged at once; swift cavalry and short blades, rhinoceros-hide shields and iron pavises, ranks in thousands, spears in millions—we halted the tyrant within seven paces and ringed Xiang in three folds; with a thunderous collapse the mass of villains was extinguished.
translations.idiomatic: We divided the martial hosts; a hundred roads converged; swift horse and short blade, rhinoceros shield and iron pavis, ranks in thousands, spears in millions—we held the tyrant within seven paces and ringed Xiang in three folds; with a thunderous rout the villains were destroyed.

sentences.zh: 京師少長，俱稱萬歲。

translations.literal: Young and old in the capital all cried ten thousand years.
translations.idiomatic: Young and old in the capital all shouted ten thousand years.

sentences.zh: 長安酒食，於此價高。

translations.literal: Food and drink in Chang'an—here the price runs high.
translations.idiomatic: Chang'an's food and drink—here the price is high.

sentences.zh: 九縣雲開，六合清朗，矧伊黔首，誰不載躍！

translations.literal: The nine districts opened like clouds; the six realms grew clear and bright—how much more the black-headed people; who would not leap for joy!
translations.idiomatic: The nine districts opened like clouds; the six realms grew clear—how much more the common people; who would not leap for joy!

sentences.zh: 伏惟陛下咀痛茹哀，嬰憤忍酷。

translations.literal: We humbly consider that Your Majesty chews grief and swallows sorrow, bears infant rage and endures cruelty.
translations.idiomatic: We consider that Your Majesty chews grief and swallows sorrow, bears rage and endures cruelty.

sentences.zh: 自紫庭絳闕，胡塵四起，壖垣好畤，冀馬雲屯，泣血治兵，嘗膽誓衆。

translations.literal: Since dust rose at the crimson court and purple gates, since ramparts and Haozhi were trampled and Ji horses clouded the land, you have wept blood while arming the hosts and tasted gall while swearing the masses.
translations.idiomatic: Since dust rose at the crimson court and purple gates, since ramparts and Haozhi were overrun and Ji horses clouded the land, you have wept blood while arming troops and tasted gall while swearing the masses.

sentences.zh: 而吳、楚一家，方與七國俱反；

translations.literal: Wu and Chu were one house, yet rose with the seven states;
translations.idiomatic: Wu and Chu were one house, yet they rose with the seven states;

sentences.zh: 管、蔡流言，又以三監作亂。

translations.literal: Guan and Cai spread slander, yet the three overseers also rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: Guan and Cai spread slander, and the three overseers rebelled as well.

sentences.zh: 西涼義衆，阻強秦而不通；

translations.literal: Righteous hosts of Western Liang were blocked by strong Qin and could not pass;
translations.idiomatic: The righteous hosts of Western Liang were blocked by strong Qin and could not pass;

sentences.zh: 幷州遺民，跨飛狐而見泯。

translations.literal: survivors of Bing province crossed Flying Fox and were lost to sight.
translations.idiomatic: the survivors of Bing province crossed Flying Fox and vanished.

sentences.zh: 豺狼當路，非止一人；

translations.literal: Wolves and jackals held the road—not one man alone;
translations.idiomatic: Wolves and jackals blocked the road—and not by one man alone;

sentences.zh: 鯨鯢不梟，倏焉五載。

translations.literal: the whale and leviathan were not beheaded, and suddenly five years had passed.
translations.idiomatic: the whale and leviathan were not beheaded, and in a flash five years had passed.

sentences.zh: 英武克振，怨恥並雪，永尋霜露，如何可言！

translations.literal: Heroic martial power has quelled the realm; grievance and shame are both washed white—yet to follow the frost and dew, how can words suffice!
translations.idiomatic: Heroic power has stirred; grievance and shame are both snowed under—yet to follow frost and dew, what words can tell it!

sentences.zh: 臣等輒依故實，奉脩社廟，使者持節，分告塋陵。

translations.literal: Your servants have therefore followed the old precedent, reverently repaired the altars of soil and grain, and sent envoys with credentials to announce at each tomb and mound.
translations.idiomatic: We have therefore followed the old precedent, reverently repaired the altars of soil and grain, and sent envoys with credentials to announce at each tomb and mound.

sentences.zh: 嗣后後升遐，龍輴未殯，承華掩曜，梓宮莫測，並卽隨由備辦，禮具凶荒。

translations.literal: The late empress has ascended; the dragon carriage is not yet interred; the Eastern Palace light is veiled; the cedar palace cannot be found—all are being prepared as the route allows, the rites complete even in bitter famine.
translations.idiomatic: The late empress has ascended; the dragon carriage is not yet buried; the Eastern Palace light is hidden; the cedar palace cannot be found—all are being prepared along the route, the rites complete even in bitter famine.

sentences.zh: 四海同哀，六軍袒哭，聖情孝友，理當感慟。

translations.literal: The four seas mourn together; the six armies bare their shoulders and weep—Your Majesty's filial feeling and brotherly love should rightly stir deep grief.
translations.idiomatic: All within the seas mourn together; the six armies bare their shoulders and weep—Your Majesty's filial heart and brotherly love should rightly move you to anguish.

sentences.zh: 日者，百司岳牧，祈仰宸鑒。

translations.literal: Recently the hundred offices and mountain governors have looked up, praying for Your Majesty's clear regard.
translations.idiomatic: Of late the hundred offices and mountain governors have looked up, praying for Your Majesty's clear gaze.

sentences.zh: 以錫珪之功，旣歸有道，當璧之禮，允屬聖明；

translations.literal: The merit of granting the jade tally has already returned to the one who holds the Way; the rite of receiving the royal tablet belongs rightly to the sage and bright—
translations.idiomatic: The merit of granting the jade tally has already returned to the holder of the Way; the rite of receiving the royal tablet rightly belongs to the sage and bright—

sentences.zh: 而優詔謙沖，窅然凝邈。

translations.literal: yet Your gracious edict is humble and restrained, remote and still.
translations.idiomatic: yet Your gracious edict remains humble and restrained, remote and still.

sentences.zh: 飛龍可躋，而《乾》爻在四；

translations.literal: The flying dragon may ascend, yet the Qian hexagram still stands in the fourth place;
translations.idiomatic: The flying dragon may ascend, yet the Qian line still stands in the fourth place;

sentences.zh: 帝閽云叫，而閶闔未開。

translations.literal: the Gate of Heaven cries out, yet the great portal is not yet opened.
translations.idiomatic: the Gate of Heaven clamors, yet the great portal has not opened.

sentences.zh: 謳歌再馳，是用翹首。

translations.literal: Ballads race forth again—therefore we crane our necks.
translations.idiomatic: Ballads race forth again—therefore we stretch our necks in hope.

sentences.zh: 所以越人固執，熏丹穴以求君；

translations.literal: Thus the men of Yue held fast, smoking the cinnabar cave to seek their lord;
translations.idiomatic: Thus the men of Yue held fast, smoking the cinnabar cave to seek a lord;

sentences.zh: 周民樂推，諭岐山而事主。

translations.literal: the people of Zhou rejoiced in pushing him forward, explaining at Mount Qi that they would serve him as lord.
translations.idiomatic: the people of Zhou rejoiced in urging him on, explaining at Mount Qi that they would serve him as lord.

sentences.zh: 漢王不卽位，無以貴功臣；

translations.literal: If the King of Han did not take the throne, he could not honor his meritorious ministers;
translations.idiomatic: If the King of Han did not take the throne, he could not exalt his meritorious ministers;

sentences.zh: 光武止蕭王，豈謂紹宗廟。

translations.literal: if Guangwu had halted the Prince of Xiao, how could he have continued the ancestral temple?
translations.idiomatic: if Guangwu had halted the Prince of Xiao, how could the ancestral temple have endured?

sentences.zh: 黃帝游於襄城，尚訪治民之道；

translations.literal: The Yellow Emperor wandered at Xiangcheng yet still sought how to govern the people;
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow Emperor wandered at Xiangcheng yet still sought the way to govern the people;

sentences.zh: 放勛入於姑射，猶使樽俎有歸。

translations.literal: Emperor Yao entered Guye yet still kept feast and sacrifice in their place.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Yao entered Guye yet still kept feast and sacrifice in their proper place.

sentences.zh: 伊此儻來，豈聖人所欲，帝王所應，不獲已而然。

translations.literal: Such chance arrival—surely not what the sage desired; what emperor and king should do, they do only when they cannot refuse.
translations.idiomatic: Such chance arrival—surely not what the sage desired; what emperors and kings must do, they do only when they cannot refuse.

sentences.zh: 伏讀璽書，尋諷制旨，顧懷物外，未奉慈衷。

translations.literal: We have read the imperial letter and traced the decree's intent—you still dwell beyond affairs and have not yet offered your compassionate heart.
translations.idiomatic: We have read the imperial letter and traced the decree's intent—you still dwell beyond affairs and have not yet turned your compassionate heart to us.

sentences.zh: 陛下日角龍顏之姿，表於徇齊之日，彤雲素氣之瑞，基於應物之初。

translations.literal: Your Majesty's sun-horn and dragon-brow were shown on the day you went forth in equal measure; the omen of crimson cloud and plain vapor was rooted from the first response to things.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty's sun-horn and dragon-brow appeared on the day you went forth in equal measure; the omen of crimson cloud and plain vapor took root from your first response to things.

sentences.zh: 博覽則大哉無所與名，深言則曄乎昭章之觀。

translations.literal: In broad reading there is nothing with which to name your greatness; in deep speech your brilliance shines like the manifest hall.
translations.idiomatic: Read broadly and your greatness has no name; speak deeply and your brilliance shines like the manifest hall.

sentences.zh: 忠爲令德，孝實動天。

translations.literal: Loyalty is the foremost virtue; filial piety truly moves Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Loyalty is the foremost virtue; filial piety truly stirs Heaven.

sentences.zh: 加以英威茂略，雄圖武算，指麾則丹浦不戰，顧眄則阪泉自盪。

translations.literal: Add heroic might and abundant strategy, bold design and martial calculation—at a gesture Dan Ford needs no battle; at a glance Banquan stirs of itself.
translations.idiomatic: Add heroic might and abundant strategy, bold design and martial calculation—at a gesture Dan Ford needs no battle; at a glance Banquan moves of itself.

sentences.zh: 地維絕而重紐，天柱傾而更植。

translations.literal: The earth's cord broke and was tied again; the heaven's pillar tilted and was set upright anew.
translations.idiomatic: The earth's cord snapped and was knotted again; the heaven's pillar leaned and was planted upright once more.

sentences.zh: 鑿河津於孟門，百川復啓；

translations.literal: The river ford at Meng Gate was cut open and the hundred streams flowed again;
translations.idiomatic: The river ford at Meng Gate was opened and the hundred streams ran again;

sentences.zh: 補穹儀以五石，萬物再生。

translations.literal: the dome of heaven was patched with five stones and the myriad things lived again.
translations.idiomatic: the dome of heaven was mended with five stones and the myriad things were born again.

sentences.zh: 縱陛下拂袗衣而游廣成，登＜山弇＞山而去東土，羣臣安得仰訴，兆庶何所歸仁。

translations.literal: Even if Your Majesty brushed the plain robe and wandered at Guangcheng, climbed Mount Yan and went east—how could your ministers raise complaint, where would the masses turn for benevolence?
translations.idiomatic: Even if Your Majesty brushed the plain robe and wandered at Guangcheng, climbed Mount Yan and went east—how could your ministers plead, where would the masses turn for grace?

sentences.zh: 況郊祀配天，罍篚禮曠，齋宮清廟，匏竹不陳，仰望鑾輿，匪朝伊夕，瞻言法駕，載渴且飢。

translations.literal: Moreover, suburban sacrifice paired with Heaven, the ritual vessels of the altar stand empty; the pure palace and clear temple lack pipe and bamboo—gazing up for the imperial carriage, not one morning or one evening; looking for the law chariot, parched and hungry together.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, suburban sacrifice paired with Heaven, the altar vessels stand empty; the pure palace and clear temple lack pipe and bamboo—gazing up for the imperial carriage, not one morning or one evening; looking for the law chariot, thirsty and hungry together.

sentences.zh: 豈可久稽衆議，有曠彜則！

translations.literal: How can you long delay the multitude's counsel and leave the constant statutes vacant!
translations.idiomatic: How can you long delay the multitude's counsel and leave the constant statutes empty!

sentences.zh: 舊郊旣復，函、雒已平。

translations.literal: The old suburban rites are restored; Hangu and Luoyang are already pacified.
translations.idiomatic: The old suburban rites have returned; Hangu and Luoyang are already pacified.

sentences.zh: 高奴、櫟陽，宮館雖毀；

translations.literal: Gaonu and Liyang—the palaces and lodges though ruined;
translations.idiomatic: Gaonu and Liyang—palaces and lodges though ruined;

sentences.zh: 濁河清渭，佳氣猶存。

translations.literal: the muddy Yellow River and clear Wei still hold their auspicious breath.
translations.idiomatic: the muddy Yellow River and clear Wei still breathe their auspicious air.

sentences.zh: 皋門有伉，甘泉四敞，土圭測景，仙人承露。

translations.literal: The outer gate stands tall; sweet springs open on four sides; the earth rod measures the shadow; the immortal receives dew.
translations.idiomatic: The outer gate stands high; sweet springs open on four sides; the earth rod measures the shadow; the immortal receives dew.

sentences.zh: 斯蓋九州之赤縣，六合之樞機。

translations.literal: This is the red county of the nine provinces, the pivot of the six realms.
translations.idiomatic: This is the red county of the nine provinces, the hinge of the six realms.

sentences.zh: 博士捧圖書而稍還，太常定禮儀而已列。

translations.literal: Erudites carry the books and charts back little by little; the Grand Master of Ceremonies has already set the rites in order.
translations.idiomatic: Erudites bear the books and charts back by degrees; the Grand Master of Ceremonies has already set the rites in order.

sentences.zh: 豈得不揚清駕而赴名都，具玉鑾而游正寢！

translations.literal: How can you fail to raise the clear carriage and go to the famed capital, fit out the jade chariot and enter the proper palace!
translations.idiomatic: How can you fail to raise the clear carriage and go to the famed capital, fit the jade chariot and enter the proper palace!

sentences.zh: 昔東周旣遷，鎬京遂其不復；

translations.literal: In old times when the Eastern Zhou moved east, Haojing was never recovered;
translations.idiomatic: In old times when the Eastern Zhou moved east, Haojing was never regained;

sentences.zh: 長安一亂，郟、洛永以爲居。

translations.literal: after one turmoil at Chang'an, Xie and Luo were forever taken as the seat.
translations.idiomatic: after one turmoil at Chang'an, Xie and Luo were forever made the seat.

sentences.zh: 夏后以萬國朝諸侯，文王以六州匡天下。

translations.literal: The Xia sovereign received the ten thousand states when the feudal lords came to court; King Wen with six provinces set the realm right.
translations.idiomatic: The Xia sovereign received the ten thousand states when the feudal lords came to court; King Wen with six provinces set the realm aright.

sentences.zh: 跡基百里，劍杖三尺。

translations.literal: His trace was rooted in a hundred li; his sword staff was three feet.
translations.idiomatic: His trace was rooted in a hundred li; his sword staff measured three feet.

sentences.zh: 以殘楚之地，抗拒九戎；

translations.literal: With the remnant land of Chu he resisted the nine barbarians;
translations.idiomatic: With the remnant lands of Chu he resisted the nine barbarians;

sentences.zh: 一旅之師，剪滅三叛。

translations.literal: with one brigade he cut down three rebellions.
translations.idiomatic: with a single brigade he cut down three rebellions.

sentences.zh: 坦然大定，御輦東歸。

translations.literal: The realm was broadly settled; the imperial carriage turned east.
translations.idiomatic: The realm was broadly settled; the imperial carriage returned east.

sentences.zh: 解五牛于冀州，秣六馬於譙郡。

translations.literal: He unyoked five oxen at Jizhou and fed six horses at Qiao commandery.
translations.idiomatic: He unyoked five oxen at Jizhou and fed six horses at Qiao commandery.

sentences.zh: 緬求前古，其可得歟？

translations.literal: Looking far back through antiquity—can such a thing be found?
translations.idiomatic: Search far back through antiquity—can such a thing be found?

sentences.zh: 對揚天命，何所讓德！

translations.literal: To answer and spread Heaven's mandate—what virtue is there to yield!
translations.idiomatic: To answer and spread Heaven's mandate—what virtue remains to yield!

sentences.zh: 有理存焉，敢重所奏。

translations.literal: Reason stands here; we venture to press our memorial again.
translations.idiomatic: Reason stands here; we dare press our memorial again.

sentences.zh: 相國答曰：「省表，復具一二。

translations.literal: The Chancellor replied: "I have reviewed your memorial and set out the points again.
translations.idiomatic: The Chancellor replied, "I have reviewed your memorial and set out the points again.

sentences.zh: 羣公卿士，億兆夷人，咸以皇天眷命，歸運所屬，用集寶位于予一人。

translations.literal: The lords and ministers, the hundred million common people—all hold that Heaven favors the mandate and the turn of fortune belongs here, gathering the precious throne upon this one man alone.
translations.idiomatic: Lords and ministers, the hundred million common people—all hold that Heaven favors the mandate and fortune's turn belongs here, gathering the precious throne upon this one man alone.

sentences.zh: 文叔金吾之官，事均往願；

translations.literal: Wen Shu's office as golden guard matched the old wish;
translations.idiomatic: Wen Shu's post as golden guard matched the old wish;

sentences.zh: 孟德征西之位，且符前說。

translations.literal: Mengde's post as western campaigner likewise fits the earlier word.
translations.idiomatic: Mengde's western campaign post likewise fits the earlier word.

sentences.zh: 今淮海長鯨，雖云授首；

translations.literal: Now the long whale of Huai and sea has indeed surrendered his head;
translations.idiomatic: Now the long whale of Huai and sea has indeed lost his head;

sentences.zh: 襄陽短狐，未全革面。

translations.literal: the short fox of Xiangyang has not yet fully changed his face.
translations.idiomatic: the short fox of Xiangyang has not yet fully turned his face.

sentences.zh: 太平玉燭，爾乃議之。

translations.literal: The jade candle of great peace—only then may it be discussed."
translations.idiomatic: The jade candle of great peace—only then may we speak of it."

sentences.zh: 」辛卯，宣猛將軍朱買臣密害豫章嗣王棟，及其二弟橋、樛，世祖志也。

translations.literal: On xinmao, Fierce Campaign General Zhu Maichen secretly killed Heir Prince Dong of Yuzhang and his two younger brothers Qiao and Jiao—per Shizu's intent.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Fierce Campaign General Zhu Maichen secretly killed Heir Prince Dong of Yuzhang and his younger brothers Qiao and Jiao—by Shizu's design.

sentences.zh: 五月庚午，司空南平王恪及宗室王侯、大都督王僧辯等，復拜表上尊號，世祖猶固讓不受。

translations.literal: On gengwu in the fifth month, Minister of Works Prince Ke of Nanping, the imperial clan princes, and Grand Commander Wang Sengbian again presented a memorial offering the exalted title; Shizu still firmly declined.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu in the fifth month, Minister of Works Prince Ke of Nanping, the imperial clan princes, and Grand Commander Wang Sengbian again offered the exalted title; Shizu still firmly refused.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以征南將軍、湘州刺史、司空南平嗣王恪爲鎮東將軍、揚州刺史，餘如故。

translations.literal: On gengchen, Heir Prince Ke of Nanping, Bearer of the Staff for Pacifying the South, Xiangzhou Inspector, and Minister of Works, was made General Who Pacifies the East and Yangzhou Inspector; the rest unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Heir Prince Ke of Nanping, Bearer of the Staff for Pacifying the South, Xiangzhou inspector, and Minister of Works, was made General Who Pacifies the East and Yangzhou inspector; the rest unchanged.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以尚書令、征東將軍、開府儀同三司、江州刺史王僧辯爲司徒、鎮衛將軍。

translations.literal: On jiashen, Director of the Masters of Writing, General Who Conquers the East, Bearer with honors equal to the Three Excellencies, and Jiangzhou Inspector Wang Sengbian was made Minister Over the Masses and General Who Guards the Realm.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Director of the Masters of Writing, General Who Conquers the East, Bearer with honors equal to the Three Excellencies, and Jiangzhou inspector Wang Sengbian was made Minister Over the Masses and General Who Guards the Realm.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，斬賊左僕射王偉、尚書呂季略、少卿周石珍、舍人嚴亶於江陵市。

translations.literal: On yiyou, the rebel Left Vice Director Wang Wei, Master of Writing Lü Jilue, Junior Minister Zhou Shizhen, and Attendant Yan Dan were beheaded in the Jiangling market.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, the rebel Left Vice Director Wang Wei, Master of Writing Lü Jilue, Junior Minister Zhou Shizhen, and Attendant Yan Dan were executed in the Jiangling market.

sentences.zh: 是日，世祖令曰：「君子赦過，著在周經；

translations.literal: That day Shizu issued an order: "The gentleman pardons offenses—this is set forth in the Zhou canon;
translations.idiomatic: That day Shizu issued an order, "The gentleman pardons offenses—this is set forth in the Zhou canon;

sentences.zh: 聖人解網，聞之湯令。

translations.literal: the sage loosens the net—this is heard in Tang's charge.
translations.idiomatic: the sage loosens the net—we hear it in Tang's charge.

sentences.zh: 自獫狁孔熾，長蛇薦食，赤縣阽危，黔黎塗炭，終宵不寐，志在雪恥。

translations.literal: Since the Xianyun burned fiercely and the long serpent fed and fed, the red land tottered on the brink and the black-headed people were smeared with charcoal—I could not sleep all night, my will set on washing away disgrace.
translations.idiomatic: Since the Xianyun burned fiercely and the long serpent fed and fed, the red land tottered and the black-headed people were smeared with charcoal—I could not sleep all night, my will fixed on washing away disgrace.

sentences.zh: 元惡稽誅，本屬侯景；

translations.literal: The chief villain who delayed punishment was none other than Hou Jing;
translations.idiomatic: The chief villain long overdue for punishment was Hou Jing alone;

sentences.zh: 王偉是其心膂，周石珍負背恩義，今並烹諸鼎鑊，肆之市朝。

translations.literal: Wang Wei was his heart and backbone; Zhou Shizhen betrayed the grace shown him—now all are boiled in the great cauldron and displayed in the market square.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Wei was his right hand; Zhou Shizhen betrayed received grace—now all are boiled in the cauldron and displayed at the market.

sentences.zh: 但比屯邅寇擾，爲歲已積，衣冠舊貴，被逼偷生，猛士勳豪，和光苟免，凡諸惡侶，諒非一族。

translations.literal: Yet compared with the recent years of bandit turmoil, time has already piled up; old nobles of cap and gown were pressed to steal life, bold warriors and meritorious lords blended their light and slipped by; all wicked companions surely are not of one clan.
translations.idiomatic: Yet turmoil from recent raids has gone on for years; old nobles were driven to survive in hiding, bold men and meritorious heroes dimmed their light to escape; evil companions surely are not all of one kind.

sentences.zh: 今特闡以王澤，削以刑書，自太清六年五月二十日昧爽以前，咸使惟新。

translations.literal: Now I specially open the royal favor and pare back the penal code—from before dawn on the twentieth day of the fifth month of Taiqing year 6, all may be made new.
translations.idiomatic: Now I open royal grace and cut back the penal statutes—from before dawn on the twentieth day of the fifth month of Taiqing 6, all are made new.

sentences.zh: 」是月，魏遣太師潘樂、辛術等寇秦郡，王僧辯遣杜崱帥衆拒之。

translations.literal: " That month, Wei sent Grand Mentor Pan Le, Xin Shu, and others to raid Qin commandery; Wang Sengbian sent Du Kan to lead the host against them.
translations.idiomatic: " That month Wei sent Grand Mentor Pan Le, Xin Shu, and others against Qin commandery; Wang Sengbian sent Du Kan with troops to resist.

sentences.zh: 以陳霸先爲征北大將軍、開府儀同三司、南徐州刺史。

translations.literal: Chen Baxian was made Grand General Who Conquers the North, Bearer with honors equal to the Three Excellencies, and South Xuzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Baxian was made Grand General Who Conquers the North, Bearer with honors equal to the Three Excellencies, and South Xuzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 是月，魏遣使賀平侯景。

translations.literal: That month Wei sent envoys to congratulate the pacification of Hou Jing.
translations.idiomatic: That month Wei sent envoys to congratulate the defeat of Hou Jing.

sentences.zh: 八月，蕭紀率巴、蜀大衆連舟東下，遣護軍陸法和屯巴峽以拒之。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Xiao Ji led the great host of Ba and Shu with ships chained in succession eastward; he sent Protector-General Lu Fahe to garrison Ba Gorge to resist him.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Xiao Ji led Ba and Shu forces chained in ships eastward; Protector-General Lu Fahe was sent to garrison Ba Gorge to resist.

sentences.zh: 兼通直散騎常侍、聘魏使徐陵於鄴奉表曰：

translations.literal: Acting Direct Regular Cavalry Attendant and envoy to Wei Xu Ling, at Ye, submitted a memorial that said:
translations.idiomatic: Acting Direct and Regular Palace Cavalry Attendant and envoy to Wei Xu Ling submitted at Ye a memorial that said,

sentences.zh: 臣聞封唐有聖，還承帝嚳之家；

translations.literal: Your subject has heard that when Tang of the fief had a sage, he still inherited the house of Emperor Ku;
translations.idiomatic: I have heard that when Tang of the fief had a sage, he still inherited Emperor Ku's house;

sentences.zh: 居代惟賢，終纂高皇之祚。

translations.literal: when one dwelling in Dai alone was worthy, he at last succeeded to the fortune of the Exalted Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: when one dwelling in Dai alone was worthy, he at last succeeded to the Exalted Emperor's throne.

sentences.zh: 無爲稱於革舄，至治表於垂衣，而撥亂反正，非聞前古。

translations.literal: Non-action was praised in changing the sandals; utmost governance showed in letting the robes hang—yet to quell disorder and restore the right was not heard in ages before.
translations.idiomatic: Non-action was praised in changing the sandals; utmost governance showed in letting the robes hang—yet to quell disorder and restore the right was unheard in antiquity.

sentences.zh: 至如金行重作，源出東莞；

translations.literal: Take for example the Metal line renewed, its source flowing from Dongguan;
translations.idiomatic: Consider the Metal line renewed, its source in Dongguan;

sentences.zh: 炎運猶昌，枝分南頓。

translations.literal: the Blaze fortune still flourishing, its branch divided at Nandun.
translations.idiomatic: the Blaze fortune still flourishing, its branch at Nandun.

sentences.zh: 豈得掩顯姓於軒轅，非才子于顓頊？

translations.literal: How could one conceal a glorious surname at the time of Yellow Emperor, or say he was no man of talent at Zhuanxu?
translations.idiomatic: How could one conceal a glorious surname at Yellow Emperor's time, or say he was no man of talent at Zhuanxu?

sentences.zh: 莫不時因多難，俱繼神宗者也。

translations.literal: All alike took their time from many hardships and together succeeded the Divine Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: All alike rose through many hardships and together succeeded the Divine Ancestor.

sentences.zh: 伏惟陛下，出《震》等於勛、華，明讓同於旦、奭。

translations.literal: I humbly consider that Your Majesty emerged from Thunder equal to Yu and Hua, your bright yielding the same as Duke of Zhou and Duke of Shao.
translations.idiomatic: I humbly consider that Your Majesty emerged from Thunder equal to Yu and Hua, your bright yielding the same as the Duke of Zhou and Duke of Shao.

sentences.zh: 握圖執鉞，將在御天，玉縢珠衡，先彰元后。

translations.literal: You hold the chart and grasp the battle-axe—you are about to mount Heaven; jade clasps and pearl measures already show the chief consort beforehand.
translations.idiomatic: You hold the chart and battle-axe—you are about to mount Heaven; jade clasps and pearl measures already proclaim the chief consort.

sentences.zh: 神祇所命，非惟太室之祥；

translations.literal: The spirits ordained this—not only the auspice of the Grand Chamber;
translations.idiomatic: The spirits ordained this—not only the Grand Chamber's auspice;

sentences.zh: 圖畫斯歸，何止堯門之瑞。

translations.literal: the charts and portraits point here—how could it be only the marvel at Yao's gate?
translations.idiomatic: the charts and portraits point here—more than the marvel at Yao's gate alone.

sentences.zh: 若夫大孝聖人之心，中庸君子之德，固以作訓生民，貽風多士。

translations.literal: As for the heart of the great filial sage and the virtue of the balanced gentleman—they are indeed made to instruct the living people and bequeath their wind to the many scholars.
translations.idiomatic: The great filial sage's heart and the balanced gentleman's virtue instruct the living and bequeath their wind to scholars.

sentences.zh: 一日二日，研覽萬機；

translations.literal: Day one, day two, you study the myriad affairs;
translations.idiomatic: Day after day you study the myriad affairs of state;

sentences.zh: 允文允武，包羅羣藝。

translations.literal: truly cultured, truly martial, embracing all the arts.
translations.idiomatic: cultured and martial alike, embracing every art.

sentences.zh: 擬茲三大，賓是四門，歷試諸難，咸熙庶績，斯無得而稱也。

translations.literal: You match the Three Great Ones and honor the Four Gates, tested through every hardship, all achievements bright—words cannot fully praise it.
translations.idiomatic: You match the Three Great Ones and honor the Four Gates, tested through every hardship, every achievement bright—beyond full praise.

sentences.zh: 自無妄興暴，皇祚寖微，封狶脩蛇，行災中國，靈心所宅，下武其興，望紫極而長號，瞻丹陵而殞慟。

translations.literal: Since Without Illusion rose in violence, the imperial fortune daily waned; the fief boar and winding serpent brought calamity through the central land. Where the numinous heart dwelt, the Martial Below arose; gazing at the purple pole he long lamented, looking toward the cinnabar mound he died in grief.
translations.idiomatic: Since Without Illusion rose in violence, the imperial fortune waned daily; the fief boar and winding serpent brought calamity through the central land. Where the numinous heart dwelt, the Martial Below arose; gazing at the purple pole he long lamented, looking toward the cinnabar mound he died in grief.

sentences.zh: 家冤將報，天賜黃鳥之旗；

translations.literal: House wrong was soon to be answered; Heaven bestowed the yellow-bird banner;
translations.idiomatic: House wrong was soon answered; Heaven bestowed the yellow-bird banner;

sentences.zh: 國害宜誅，神奉玄狐之籙。

translations.literal: national harm must be punished; the spirits gave the dark-fox tally.
translations.idiomatic: national harm had to be punished; the spirits gave the dark-fox tally.

sentences.zh: 滕公擁樹，雄氣方嚴；

translations.literal: Duke of Teng embraced the tree—his heroic breath grew stern;
translations.idiomatic: Duke of Teng embraced the tree—his heroic spirit grew stern;

sentences.zh: 張繡交兵，風神彌勇。

translations.literal: Zhang Xiu met arms in battle—his wind-spirit grew bolder still.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Xiu met arms in battle—his fighting spirit grew bolder still.

sentences.zh: 忠誠冠於日月，孝義感於冰霜。

translations.literal: Loyalty and faith crowned sun and moon; filial duty and righteousness moved even frost and ice.
translations.idiomatic: Loyalty outshone sun and moon; filial duty and righteousness moved frost and ice.

sentences.zh: 如霆如雷，如貔如虎，前驅效命，元惡斯殲。

translations.literal: Like thunder, like lightning, like bear and tiger—the vanguard gave their lives and the chief villain was destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: Like thunder and lightning, like bear and tiger—the vanguard gave their lives and the chief villain fell.

sentences.zh: 旣掛膽於西州，方燃臍於東市。

translations.literal: His guts were already hung in the western prefecture; at the eastern market his navel was set aflame.
translations.idiomatic: His guts already hung in the western prefecture; at the eastern market his navel burned.

sentences.zh: 蚩尤三冢，寧謂嚴誅？

translations.literal: Three mounds for Chiyou—could one call that a harsh punishment?
translations.idiomatic: Three mounds for Chiyou—was that harsh punishment?

sentences.zh: 王莽千剸，非云明罰？

translations.literal: A thousand cuts for Wang Mang—not what one calls a clear penalty?
translations.idiomatic: A thousand cuts for Wang Mang—was that clear penalty?

sentences.zh: 青羌赤狄，同畀豺狼，胡服夷言，咸爲京觀。

translations.literal: Green Qiang and red Di were alike cast to wolves; barbarian dress and alien speech all became capital mounds.
translations.idiomatic: Green Qiang and red Di alike were cast to wolves; barbarian dress and alien speech all became execution mounds.

sentences.zh: 邦畿濟濟，還見隆平；

translations.literal: The royal domain flows thick again—peaceful harvest returns;
translations.idiomatic: The royal domain teems again—peaceful harvest returns;

sentences.zh: 宗廟愔愔，方承多福。

translations.literal: the ancestral temples murmur deep, about to receive abundant blessing.
translations.idiomatic: the ancestral temples murmur deep, ready to receive abundant blessing.

sentences.zh: 自氤氳渾沌之世，驪連、栗陸之君，卦起龍圖，文因鳥跡。

translations.literal: From the misty chaos age, the lords of Lilian and Lulu; the hexagrams rose from the dragon chart, writing followed the bird tracks.
translations.idiomatic: From misty chaos, the lords of Lilian and Lulu; hexagrams rose from the dragon chart, writing from bird tracks.

sentences.zh: 雲師火帝，非無戰陣之風，堯誓湯征，咸用干戈之道。

translations.literal: Cloud Master and Fire Emperor were not without the wind of battle arrays; Yao's oath and Tang's campaign both used the way of arms.
translations.idiomatic: Cloud Master and Fire Emperor knew the wind of battle; Yao's oath and Tang's campaign both took up arms.

sentences.zh: 星躔東井，時破崤、潼；

translations.literal: The star lodged in the Eastern Well—then Xiao and Tong were broken;
translations.idiomatic: When the star lodged in the Eastern Well, Xiao and Tong were broken;

sentences.zh: 雷震南陽，初平尋、邑。

translations.literal: thunder shook Nanyang—the first pacification of Xun and Yi.
translations.idiomatic: when thunder shook Nanyang, Xun and Yi were first pacified.

sentences.zh: 未有援三靈之已墜，救四海之羣飛，赫赫明明，龔行天罰，如當今之盛者也。

translations.literal: Never was there one who shored up the three spirits when they had fallen, rescued the flocking flight of the four seas, majestic and bright, inheriting Heaven's punishment—such as the splendor of today.
translations.idiomatic: Never was there one who shored up fallen spirits, rescued the four seas in flight, majestic and bright, inheriting Heaven's punishment—such splendor as today.

sentences.zh: 於是卿雲似蓋，晨映姚鄉；

translations.literal: Then auspicious clouds like canopies at dawn lit Yaocun;
translations.idiomatic: Then auspicious clouds like canopies at dawn lit Yao's village;

sentences.zh: 甘露如珠，朝華景寢。

translations.literal: sweet dew like pearls at morning graced the scenic palace.
translations.idiomatic: sweet dew like pearls at morning graced the scenic hall.

sentences.zh: 芝房感德，咸出銅池；

translations.literal: Spirit fungus chambers sensed virtue and all emerged from the bronze pool;
translations.idiomatic: Spirit fungus sensed virtue and all emerged from the bronze pool;

sentences.zh: 蓂莢伺辰，無勞銀箭。

translations.literal: the caltrop-leaf plant watched the hours—no need for silver clepsydra rods.
translations.idiomatic: the caltrop-leaf plant marked the hours—no need for silver clepsydra rods.

sentences.zh: 重以東漸玄菟，西逾白狼，高柳生風，扶桑盛日，莫不編名屬國，歸質鴻臚，荒服來賓，遐邇同福。

translations.literal: Add that east to Xuantu, west beyond White Wolf, where high willows bring wind and Fusang holds the full sun—none failed to register names among tributary states, send pledges to the Grand Herald Office; distant realms came as guests, near and far alike in blessing.
translations.idiomatic: East to Xuantu, west beyond White Wolf, where high willows bring wind and Fusang holds the full sun—all registered as tributaries, sent pledges to the Grand Herald Office; distant realms came as guests, near and far in one blessing.

sentences.zh: 其文昭武穆，跗萼也如彼；

translations.literal: His civil splendor and martial reverence, root and calyx like that;
translations.idiomatic: His civil splendor and martial reverence, root and calyx entwined;

sentences.zh: 天平地成，功業也如此。

translations.literal: Heaven level, earth complete—his achievement likewise.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven level, earth complete—his achievement the same.

sentences.zh: 久應旁求掌故，諮詢天官，斟酌繁昌，經營高邑。

translations.literal: Long ago he should have sought historians at the side, consulted the celestial officers, weighed Fanchang, and laid out Gaoyi.
translations.idiomatic: Long ago historians should have been sought at his side, celestial officers consulted, Fanchang weighed, Gaoyi laid out.

sentences.zh: 宗王啓霸，非勞陽武之侯；

translations.literal: An imperial prince opens hegemony—no need for the marquis of Yangwu;
translations.idiomatic: An imperial prince opens hegemony—no need for Yangwu's marquis;

sentences.zh: 清蹕無虞，何事長安之邸。

translations.literal: the cleared road needs no worry—why trouble the lodge at Chang'an?
translations.idiomatic: the cleared road needs no worry—why trouble the lodge at Chang'an?

sentences.zh: 正應揚鑾旂以饗帝，仰鳳扆以承天，歷數在躬，疇與爲讓！

translations.literal: He should raise the imperial entourage banner to feast the Emperor, look up to the phoenix screen to receive Heaven—the succession is on his person; who could share in yielding!
translations.idiomatic: He should raise the imperial entourage banner to feast the Emperor, look up to the phoenix screen to receive Heaven—the succession is on his person; who could share in yielding!

sentences.zh: 去月二十日，兼散騎常侍柳暉等至鄴，伏承聖旨謙沖，爲而弗宰，或云涇陽未復，函谷無泥，旋駕金陵，方膺天眷。

translations.literal: On the twentieth of last month the Acting Regular Cavalry Attendant Liu Hui and others reached Ye; I humbly received the sacred will of modest restraint, governing yet not ruling—or it was said Jingyang was not yet recovered, Tong Pass had no mud, and you would soon turn your carriage to Jinling and then receive Heaven's favor.
translations.idiomatic: On the twentieth of last month Acting Regular Cavalry Attendant Liu Hui and others reached Ye; I humbly received the sacred will of modest restraint, governing yet not ruling—or it was said Jingyang was not yet recovered, Tong Pass had no mud, and you would soon turn your carriage to Jinling and receive Heaven's favor.

sentences.zh: 愚謂大庭、少昊，非有定居；

translations.literal: I foolishly consider that the Grand Hall and Shaohao had no fixed dwelling;
translations.idiomatic: I foolishly think the Grand Hall and Shaohao had no fixed dwelling;

sentences.zh: 漢祖、殷宗，皆無恒宅。

translations.literal: the Han Ancestor and Yin Founder likewise had no permanent house.
translations.idiomatic: the Han Ancestor and Yin Founder likewise had no permanent seat.

sentences.zh: 登封岱岳，猶置明堂；

translations.literal: Mounting Feng on Mount Tai, they still set up the Bright Hall;
translations.idiomatic: Even mounting Feng on Mount Tai, they still set up the Bright Hall;

sentences.zh: 巡狩章陵，時行司隸。

translations.literal: touring Zhangling, they at times exercised the Metropolitan Intendant office.
translations.idiomatic: even touring Zhangling, they at times exercised the Metropolitan Intendant office.

sentences.zh: 何必西瞻虎據，乃建王宮；

translations.literal: Why must one look west to the tiger's hold before building the royal palace;
translations.idiomatic: Why look west to the tiger's hold before building the royal palace;

sentences.zh: 南望牛頭，方稱天闕。

translations.literal: or south to Ox Head before calling it the celestial gate?
translations.idiomatic: or south to Ox Head before naming the celestial gate?

sentences.zh: 抑又聞之：玄圭旣錫，蒼玉無陳，乃棫樸之愆期，非苞茅之不貢。

translations.literal: Moreover I have heard: when the black gui was already granted, blue jade was not laid out—this was a missed season for oaken faggots, not failure to offer the bundled thatch.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover I have heard: once the black gui was granted, blue jade went unlaid—this was a missed season for oaken faggots, not failure to offer bundled thatch.

sentences.zh: 雲和之瑟，久廢甘泉；

translations.literal: The Yunhe zither long lay idle at Sweet Springs;
translations.idiomatic: The Yunhe zither long lay idle at Sweet Springs;

sentences.zh: 孤竹之管，無聞方澤。

translations.literal: the Guzhu pipes had no sound at the square marsh altar.
translations.idiomatic: the Guzhu pipes had not sounded at the square marsh altar.

sentences.zh: 豈不懼歟！

translations.literal: Is one not afraid!
translations.idiomatic: Should one not fear!

sentences.zh: 伏願陛下因百姓之心，拯萬邦之命。

translations.literal: I humbly pray Your Majesty will follow the hearts of the hundred surnames and rescue the mandate of ten thousand states.
translations.idiomatic: I humbly pray Your Majesty will follow the people's hearts and rescue the mandate of ten thousand states.

sentences.zh: 豈可逡巡固讓，方求石戶之農；

translations.literal: How can you linger in obstinate yielding and go seek the farmer of Stone Door;
translations.idiomatic: How can you linger in obstinate yielding and seek the farmer of Stone Door;

sentences.zh: 高謝君臨，徒引箕山之客！

translations.literal: loftily decline to rule and merely draw the guest of Mount Ji!
translations.idiomatic: loftily decline to rule and only summon the guest of Mount Ji!

sentences.zh: 未知上德之不德，惟見聖人之不仁。

translations.literal: One will not know that supreme virtue is without virtue—one will only see that the sage is without humaneness.
translations.idiomatic: One will not know supreme virtue is without virtue—one will only see the sage is without humaneness.

sentences.zh: 率士翹翹，蒼生何望！

translations.literal: All the land cranes upward—what hope have the black-headed people!
translations.idiomatic: All the land cranes upward—what hope remains for the black-headed people!

sentences.zh: 昔蘇季、張儀，違鄉負俗，尚復招三方以事趙，請六國以尊秦。

translations.literal: Of old Su Qin and Zhang Yi defied their native towns and bore down on custom, yet still rallied three regions to serve Zhao and asked six states to honor Qin.
translations.idiomatic: Of old Su Qin and Zhang Yi defied hometown and custom, yet still rallied three regions for Zhao and asked six states to honor Qin.

sentences.zh: 況臣等顯奉皇華，親承朝命，珪璋特達，通聘河陽，貂珥雍容，尋盟漳水，加牢貶館，隨勢汙隆，瞻望鄉關，誠均休戚。

translations.literal: How much more we, plainly bearing the imperial radiance, personally receiving the court's command—jade tablet and scepter expressly sent, ties opened at Heyang; sable cap and ear-insignia in dignity, alliances traced at Zhang River—we were doubled in our lodgings or lowered with the times, yet gazing toward home, our joy and grief were truly one.
translations.idiomatic: How much more we, plainly bearing the imperial radiance, personally receiving the court's command—jade tablet and scepter expressly sent, ties opened at Heyang; sable cap and ear-insignia in dignity, alliances traced at Zhang River—we were doubled in our lodgings or lowered with the times, yet gazing toward home, our joy and grief were truly one.

sentences.zh: 但輕生不造，命與時乖。

translations.literal: Yet my slight life was ill-fated; my destiny crossed the times.
translations.idiomatic: Yet my slight life was ill-fated; fate crossed the times.

sentences.zh: 忝一介之行人，同三危之遠擯。

translations.literal: I disgracefully rank as a single courier, banished far as the Three Perils.
translations.idiomatic: I disgracefully rank as a lone courier, banished as far as the Three Perils.

sentences.zh: 承閒內殿，事絕耿弇之恩；

translations.literal: Granted leisure in the inner hall, I lacked even Geng Yan's favor;
translations.idiomatic: Granted leisure in the inner hall, I lacked even Geng Yan's grace;

sentences.zh: 封奏邊城，私等劉琨之哭。

translations.literal: sealed memorials at the border fortress, I privately matched Liu Kun's weeping.
translations.idiomatic: sealed memorials at the border fortress, I privately echoed Liu Kun's weeping.

sentences.zh: 不勝區區之至，謹拜表以聞。

translations.literal: Unable to bear this trifling utmost, I respectfully bow this memorial to inform you.
translations.idiomatic: Unable to bear this trifling utmost, I respectfully submit this memorial.

sentences.zh: 九月甲戌，司空、鎮東將軍、揚州刺史南平王恪薨。

translations.literal: On jiaxu in the ninth month, Minister Over the Masses, General Who Conquers the East, and Yangzhou Inspector Prince Ke of Nanping died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu in the ninth month, Minister Over the Masses, General Who Conquers the East, and Yangzhou inspector Prince Ke of Nanping died.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙未，前梁州刺史蕭循自魏至于江陵，以循爲平北將軍、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on yiwei, former Liangzhou Inspector Xiao Xun came from Wei to Jiangling; Xun was made General Who Pacifies the North and Bearer with honors equal to the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, on yiwei, former Liangzhou inspector Xiao Xun came from Wei to Jiangling; Xun was made General Who Pacifies the North and Bearer with honors equal to the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 戊申，執湘州刺史王琳於殿內，琳副將殷晏下獄死。

translations.literal: On wushen, Xiangzhou Inspector Wang Lin was seized in the palace; Lin's deputy Yin Yan was cast into prison and died.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Xiangzhou inspector Wang Lin was seized in the palace; Lin's deputy Yin Yan was cast into prison and died.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以子方略爲湘州刺史。

translations.literal: On xinyou, Fanglue was made Xiangzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Fanglue was made Xiangzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，琳長史陸納及其將潘烏累等舉兵反，襲陷湘州。

translations.literal: On gengxu, Lin's Chief Clerk Lu Na and his generals Pan Wulei and others rose in arms, raided and seized Xiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Lin's chief clerk Lu Na and his generals Pan Wulei and others rose in arms, raided and seized Xiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 是月，四方征鎮王公卿士復勸世祖卽尊號，猶謙讓未許。

translations.literal: That month the regional commanders, princes, and officials of court and field again urged Shizu to take the imperial title; he still modestly yielded and did not consent.
translations.idiomatic: That month commanders, princes, and officials again urged Shizu to take the imperial throne; he still modestly refused.

sentences.zh: 表三上，乃從之。

translations.literal: When the memorials came three times, he at last assented.
translations.idiomatic: After three submissions he at last assented.

sentences.zh: 承聖元年冬十一月丙子，世祖卽皇帝位於江陵。

translations.literal: On bingzi in the eleventh month of winter, Chengsheng year 1, Shizu took the imperial throne at Jiangling.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi in the eleventh month of winter, Chengsheng 1, Shizu took the throne at Jiangling.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「夫樹之以君，司牧黔首。

translations.literal: An edict said: "To plant a ruler over the people is to shepherd the black-headed masses.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said, "To set up a ruler is to shepherd the people.

sentences.zh: 帝堯之心，豈貴黃屋，誠弗獲已而臨蒞之。

translations.literal: Emperor Yao's heart—how could he have prized the yellow canopy? He truly could not refuse, and so came to rule over them.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Yao's heart did not prize the yellow canopy; he truly could not refuse, and so came to rule.

sentences.zh: 朕皇祖太祖文皇帝積德岐、梁，化行江、漢，道映在田，具瞻斯屬。

translations.literal: Our imperial grandfather the Literary Emperor accumulated virtue in Qi and Liang; his transforming influence ran through the rivers Han; his Way shone in the fields, and all looked up to him.
translations.idiomatic: Our imperial grandfather the Literary Emperor accumulated virtue in Qi and Liang; his transforming influence ran through the Jiang and Han; his Way shone in the fields and all looked to him.

sentences.zh: 皇考高祖武皇帝明並日月，功格區宇，應天從民，惟睿作聖。

translations.literal: Our imperial father Gaozu the Martial Emperor made his brightness equal sun and moon, his merit reach the realms; he followed Heaven and the people; only the sagely could act.
translations.idiomatic: Our imperial father Gaozu the Martial Emperor matched sun and moon, his merit reaching the realms; he followed Heaven and the people with sagely judgment.

sentences.zh: 太宗簡文皇帝地侔啓、誦，方符文、景。

translations.literal: Taizong Jianwen the Emperor matched Qi and Song, was patterned on Wen and Jing.
translations.idiomatic: Taizong Jianwen matched Qi and Song, was patterned on Wen and Jing.

sentences.zh: 羯寇憑陵，時難孔棘。

translations.literal: The Jie bandit leaned on force; the time's hardship was extreme.
translations.idiomatic: The Jie invader leaned on arms; the age's hardship was extreme.

sentences.zh: 朕大拯橫流，克復宗社。

translations.literal: We greatly rescued the drifting current and recovered the ancestral altars.
translations.idiomatic: We greatly rescued the drifting flood and recovered the ancestral altars.

sentences.zh: 羣公卿士、百辟庶僚，咸以皇靈眷命，歸運斯及，天命不可以久淹，宸極不可以久曠。

translations.literal: All the dukes and officials, the hundred offices and the multitude, alike hold that the imperial spirit favors the mandate and the fortune has arrived—the Heavenly mandate cannot long be delayed, the imperial pole cannot long stand vacant.
translations.idiomatic: All dukes, officials, and the hundred bureaus hold that the imperial spirit favors the mandate and fortune has arrived—Heaven's mandate cannot long be delayed, the throne cannot long stand empty.

sentences.zh: 粵若前載，憲章令範，畏天之威，算隆寶曆，用集神器于予一人。

translations.literal: Looking to the former records and the statutes and models, in awe of Heaven's might we count the lofty calendar and with it gather the sacred vessel on this lone person.
translations.idiomatic: Looking to former records and statute models, in awe of Heaven's might we count the lofty calendar and gather the sacred vessel on this lone person.

sentences.zh: 昔虞、夏、商、周，年無嘉號，漢、魏、晉、宋，因循以久。

translations.literal: Of old Yu, Xia, Shang, and Zhou had no fine era names; Han, Wei, Jin, and Song followed along for long.
translations.idiomatic: Of old Yu, Xia, Shang, and Zhou had no fine era names; Han, Wei, Jin, and Song followed along a long while.

sentences.zh: 朕雖云撥亂，且非創業，思得上繫宗祧，下惠億兆。

translations.literal: Although we speak of quelling disorder, it is not founding anew; we think to link above to the ancestral shrine and below to bless the hundred millions.
translations.idiomatic: Though we speak of quelling disorder, it is not founding anew; we seek to link above to the ancestral shrine and below to bless the hundred millions.

sentences.zh: 可改太清六年爲承聖元年。

translations.literal: Taiqing year 6 may be changed to Chengsheng year 1.
translations.idiomatic: Taiqing 6 may be changed to Chengsheng 1.

sentences.zh: 逋租宿責，並許弘貸；

translations.literal: Arrears of rent and old debts may all be broadened in remission;
translations.idiomatic: Arrears of rent and old debts may all be remitted broadly;

sentences.zh: 孝子義孫，可悉賜爵；

translations.literal: filial sons and righteous grandsons may all be granted noble rank;
translations.idiomatic: filial sons and righteous grandsons may all receive noble rank;

sentences.zh: 長徒鏁士，特加原宥；

translations.literal: long-term convicts in chains may specially receive pardon;
translations.idiomatic: long-term convicts in chains may specially be pardoned;

sentences.zh: 禁錮奪勞，一皆曠盪。

translations.literal: forbidden-service penalties and labor seizure may all be wholly cleared.
translations.idiomatic: forbidden-service penalties and seized labor may all be wholly cleared.

sentences.zh: 」是日世祖不升正殿，公卿陪列而已。

translations.literal: " That day Shizu did not ascend the main hall—only the dukes and officials stood in attendance.
translations.idiomatic: " That day Shizu did not ascend the main hall; only the dukes and officials stood in attendance.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以平北將軍、開府儀同三司蕭循爲驃騎將軍、湘州刺史，餘如故。

translations.literal: On dingchou, General Who Pacifies the North, Opening Office Equal in Three Departments Xiao Xun was made Grand General of Fast Cavalry and Xiangzhou Inspector, his other offices unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, General Who Pacifies the North Xiao Xun, Opening Office Equal in Three Departments, was made Grand General of Fast Cavalry and Xiangzhou inspector, retaining his other posts.

sentences.zh: 己卯，立王太子方矩爲皇太子，改名元良。

translations.literal: On jimao, Crown Prince Fang Ju was established as crown prince and renamed Yuanliang.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Crown Prince Fang Ju was installed as crown prince and took the name Yuanliang.

sentences.zh: 立皇子方智爲晉安郡王，方略爲始安郡王。

translations.literal: Imperial sons Fang Zhi and Fang Lue were established as Princes of Jin'an and Shian commanderies.
translations.idiomatic: The princes Fang Zhi and Fang Lue were made Prince of Jin'an and Prince of Shian commanderies.

sentences.zh: 追尊所生妣阮脩容爲文宣太后。

translations.literal: His birth mother, Honored Consort Ruan, was posthumously honored as Empress Wenxuan.
translations.idiomatic: His birth mother Honored Consort Ruan was posthumously titled Empress Wenxuan.

sentences.zh: 是月，陸納遣將潘烏累等攻破衡州刺史丁道貴於淥口，道貴走零陵。

translations.literal: That month, Lu Na sent generals Pan Wulei and others to defeat Hengzhou Inspector Ding Daogui at Lukou; Daogui fled to Lingling.
translations.idiomatic: That month Lu Na sent Pan Wulei and other generals to break Hengzhou inspector Ding Daogui at Lukou; Daogui fled to Lingling.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬子，陸納分兵襲巴陵，湘州刺史蕭循擊破之。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on renzi, Lu Na detached troops to raid Baling; Xiangzhou Inspector Xiao Xun defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi in the twelfth month Lu Na detached troops against Baling; Xiangzhou inspector Xiao Xun routed them.

sentences.zh: 是月，營州刺史李洪雅自零陵率衆出空靈灘，將下討納，納遣將吳藏等襲破洪雅，洪雅退守空靈城。

translations.literal: That month, Yingzhou Inspector Li Hongya led his host from Lingling out through Kongling Ford, intending to descend and attack Na; Na sent General Wu Zang and others to raid and defeat Hongya, who retreated to hold Kongling city.
translations.idiomatic: That month Yingzhou inspector Li Hongya marched from Lingling through Kongling Ford to attack Na from below; Na sent Wu Zang and others to strike him down, and Hongya fell back on Kongling.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月乙丑，詔王僧辯率衆軍士討陸納。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month, on yichou, year 2, an edict ordered Wang Sengbian to lead the hosts against Lu Na.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou in the first month of spring, year 2, an edict ordered Wang Sengbian to take the armies against Lu Na.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以吏部尚書王褒爲尚書右僕射，劉瑴爲吏部尚書。

translations.literal: On wuyin, Minister of Civil Appointments Wang Bao was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing; Liu Yan was made Minister of Civil Appointments.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Minister of Civil Appointments Wang Bao became Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, and Liu Yan became Minister of Civil Appointments.

sentences.zh: 西魏遣大將尉遲迥襲益州。

translations.literal: Western Wei sent Grand General Yuchi Jiong to raid Yi Province.
translations.idiomatic: Western Wei sent Grand General Yuchi Jiong against Yi Province.

sentences.zh: 三月庚午，詔曰：「食乃民天，農爲治本，垂之千載，貽諸百王，莫不敬授民時，躬耕帝籍。

translations.literal: In the third month, on gengwu, an edict said: "Food is the people's heaven and agriculture the root of governance; handed down for a thousand years and bequeathed to the hundred kings, none failed to respectfully grant the seasons to the people and personally plow the imperial fields.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu in the third month an edict said, "Food is the people's heaven and farming the root of rule; for a thousand years the hundred kings have handed this down—none failed to grant the seasons and plow the imperial fields themselves.

sentences.zh: 是以稼穡爲寶，《周頌》嘉其樂章；

translations.literal: Therefore grain was held as treasure, and the Zhou Odes praise its hymns;
translations.idiomatic: Grain was treasure, and the Zhou Odes sing its hymns;

sentences.zh: 禾麥不成，魯史書其方册。

translations.literal: when grain and wheat did not ripen, the Lu Annals recorded it in their registers.
translations.idiomatic: when grain and wheat failed, the Lu chronicle entered it in the registers.

sentences.zh: 秦人有農力之科，漢氏開屯田之利。

translations.literal: Qin had statutes for agricultural strength; Han opened the benefit of garrison farming.
translations.idiomatic: Qin graded men by farming strength; Han opened the profit of frontier colonies.

sentences.zh: 頃歲屯否，多難荐臻，干戈不戢，我則未暇。

translations.literal: In recent years obstruction piled upon obstruction, many calamities came in succession, arms never stilled—and I had no leisure.
translations.idiomatic: In recent years the times turned hard, calamities followed one another, and war never ceased—I had no leisure for this.

sentences.zh: 廣田之令，無聞於郡國；

translations.literal: Edicts for broadening the fields were unheard in commanderies and kingdoms;
translations.idiomatic: Orders to open more land were not heard in the commanderies;

sentences.zh: 載師之職，有陋於官方。

translations.literal: the office of the Agricultural Master was neglected in the bureaucracy.
translations.idiomatic: the Agricultural Master's office had grown shabby in the official ranks.

sentences.zh: 今元惡殄殲，海內方一，其大庇黔首，庶拯橫流。

translations.literal: Now the chief villain is exterminated and the realm is becoming one; there should be great shelter for the black-headed people, that the drifting masses may be rescued.
translations.idiomatic: Now the great evil is destroyed and the realm is one; let the common people be sheltered broadly and the adrift multitude saved.

sentences.zh: 一廛曠務，勞心日仄；

translations.literal: One hamlet's work left idle grieves the heart day by day;
translations.idiomatic: One hamlet idle grieves the heart from dawn to dusk;

sentences.zh: 一夫廢業，舄鹵無遺。

translations.literal: one man's occupation abandoned—and the salt flats know no surplus.
translations.idiomatic: one man's trade abandoned—and even the salt marshes have nothing left.

sentences.zh: 國富刑清，家給民足。

translations.literal: The state rich, punishments clear; households supplied, the people sufficient.
translations.idiomatic: Let the state be rich and punishments clear, households full and the people at ease.

sentences.zh: 其力田之身，在所蠲免。

translations.literal: Those who exert themselves in the fields shall be exempted wherever they are.
translations.idiomatic: All who labor in the fields shall be exempted in their districts.

sentences.zh: 外卽宣勒，稱朕意焉。

translations.literal: Proclaim this abroad at once, in keeping with my intent.
translations.idiomatic: Proclaim this abroad at once, as my will.

sentences.zh: 」辛未，李洪雅以空靈城降賊，賊執之而歸。

translations.literal: On xinwei, Li Hongya surrendered Kongling city to the rebels; the rebels seized him and took him away.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Li Hongya surrendered Kongling to the rebels; they seized him and carried him off.

sentences.zh: 初，丁道貴走零陵投洪雅，洪雅使收餘衆。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Ding Daogui fled to Lingling he threw himself on Hongya, and Hongya had him gather the remaining troops.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Ding Daogui had fled to Lingling and sought Hongya, who ordered the remnant troops collected.

sentences.zh: 與之俱降。

translations.literal: They surrendered together.
translations.idiomatic: The two surrendered together.

sentences.zh: 洪雅旣降賊，賊乃害道貴。

translations.literal: After Hongya had surrendered to the rebels, the rebels then killed Daogui.
translations.idiomatic: Once Hongya had surrendered, the rebels killed Daogui.

sentences.zh: 丙子，賊將吳藏等帥兵據車輪。

translations.literal: On bingzi, the rebel generals Wu Zang and others led troops to seize Chelun.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi rebel generals Wu Zang and others took Chelun with their troops.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，有兩龍見湘州西江。

translations.literal: On gengyin, two dragons were seen on the western river of Xiang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin two dragons appeared on Xiang Province's western river.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙申，僧辯軍次車輪。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on bingshen, Sengbian's army halted at Chelun.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen in the fourth month of summer Sengbian's army camped at Chelun.

sentences.zh: 五月甲子，衆軍攻賊，大破之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on jiazi, the hosts attacked the rebels and routed them utterly.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi in the fifth month the armies attacked the rebels and broke them completely.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，僧辯軍至長沙。

translations.literal: On yichou, Sengbian's army reached Changsha.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Sengbian's army arrived at Changsha.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，尉遲迥進逼巴西，潼州刺史楊虔運以城降，納迥。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, Yuchi Jiong pressed close to Baxi; Tong Province Inspector Yang Qianyun surrendered the city and received Jiong.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Yuchi Jiong advanced on Baxi; Tongzhou inspector Yang Qianyun surrendered the city to him.

sentences.zh: 己丑，蕭紀軍至西陵。

translations.literal: On jichou, Xiao Ji's army reached Xiling.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Xiao Ji's army came to Xiling.

sentences.zh: 六月乙卯，湘州平。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on yimao, Xiang Province was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao in the sixth month Xiang Province was pacified.

sentences.zh: 是月，尉遲迥圍益州。

translations.literal: That month, Yuchi Jiong besieged Yi Province.
translations.idiomatic: That month Yuchi Jiong besieged Yi Province.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛未，巴人苻升、徐子初斬賊城主公孫晁，舉城來降。
