translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on xinwei, the Ba men Fu Sheng and Xu Zichu beheaded the rebel city chief Gongsun Chao and surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei in the seventh month of autumn the Ba men Fu Sheng and Xu Zichu slew the rebel commandant Gongsun Chao and offered up the city.

sentences.zh: 紀衆大潰，遇兵死。

translations.literal: Ji's host collapsed in great rout; those who met troops died.
translations.idiomatic: Ji's forces collapsed; whoever met the army died.

sentences.zh: 乙未，王僧辯班師江陵，詔諸軍各還所鎮。

translations.literal: On yiwei, Wang Sengbian withdrew his army to Jiangling; an edict ordered the hosts each to return to their garrisons.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Wang Sengbian led the army back to Jiangling, and an edict sent the hosts to their posts.

sentences.zh: 八月戊戌，尉遲迥陷益州。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on wuxu, Yuchi Jiong took Yi Province.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu in the eighth month Yuchi Jiong captured Yi Province.

sentences.zh: 庚子，詔曰：「夫爰始居毫，不廢先王之都；

translations.literal: On gengzi, an edict said: "From the first dwelling at Bo one did not abandon the capital of the former kings;
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi an edict said, "From the first settlement at Bo the former kings' capital was not cast aside;

sentences.zh: 受命于周，無改舊邦之頌。

translations.literal: receiving the mandate from Zhou, one did not alter the old realm's praise.
translations.idiomatic: receiving Zhou's mandate, the old realm's praise was not changed.

sentences.zh: 頃戎旃旣息，關柝無警。

translations.literal: Recently the war banners have rested and the frontier watch-towers are quiet.
translations.idiomatic: Lately the war banners have ceased and the frontier passes are unalarmed.

sentences.zh: 去魯興嘆，有感宵分，過沛殞涕，實勞夕寐。

translations.literal: To leave Lu and sigh, moved even at midnight; to pass Pei and shed tears, truly laboring through the night's sleep.
translations.idiomatic: Leaving Lu one sighs, stirred even at midnight; passing Pei one weeps, kept awake through the night.

sentences.zh: 仍以瀟、湘作亂，庸、蜀阻兵，命將授律，指期克定。

translations.literal: Yet Xiao and Xiang still rebelled, Yong and Shu still barred arms—generals were appointed and statutes given, with a set day for pacification.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the Xiao and Xiang still rose, Yong and Shu still bore arms; commanders were named, laws issued, and a day fixed for victory.

sentences.zh: 今八表乂清，四郊無壘，宜從青蓋之典，言歸白水之鄉。

translations.literal: Now the eight regions are ordered and the four suburbs know no rampart; it is fitting to follow the canon of the green canopy and speak of returning to the homeland of white water.
translations.idiomatic: Now the eight directions are at peace and the four suburbs have no walls; we should follow the rite of the green canopy and speak of returning to the white-water homeland.

sentences.zh: 江、湘委輸，方船連舳，巴峽舟艦，精甲百萬，先次建鄴，行實京師，然後六軍遄征，九旂揚旆，拜謁塋陵，脩復宗社。

translations.literal: Jiang and Xiang will send tribute, square-keeled ships chained bow to stern; Ba Gorge war craft and a million elite armors will first reach Jianye to manifest the capital, then the six armies will march swiftly, the nine banners raise their staffs, to bow at the imperial tombs and restore the ancestral altars.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang and Xiang will send grain by linked convoys; Ba Gorge fleets and a million armored men will first reach Jianye to show the capital, then the six armies will march, nine banners rise, to bow at the tombs and restore the altars.

sentences.zh: 主者詳依舊典，以時宣勒。」

translations.literal: The responsible offices should follow the old statutes in detail and proclaim this in season."
translations.idiomatic: Let the responsible offices follow the old statutes in detail and proclaim this in season."

sentences.zh: 九月庚午，司徒王僧辯旋鎮。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on gengwu, Minister Over the Masses Wang Sengbian returned to his command.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu in the ninth month Minister Over the Masses Wang Sengbian returned to his post.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以護軍將軍陸法和爲郢州刺史。

translations.literal: On bingzi, Protector-General Lu Fahe was made Yingzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Protector-General Lu Fahe was made Yingzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以晉安王方智爲江州刺史。

translations.literal: On yiyou, Prince of Jin'an Fang Zhi was made Jiangzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Prince Fang Zhi of Jin'an was made Jiangzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 是月，魏遣郭元建治舟師於合肥，又遣大將邢杲遠、步六汗薩、東方老率衆會之。

translations.literal: That month, Wei sent Guo Yuanjian to manage a fleet at Hefei, and also sent Grand Generals Xing Guoyuan, Buluohan Sa, and Dongfang Lao with hosts to join him.
translations.idiomatic: That month Wei sent Guo Yuanjian to ready ships at Hefei, and Grand Generals Xing Guoyuan, Buluohan Sa, and Dongfang Lao with armies to join him.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月辛酉，僧辨次于姑孰，卽留鎮焉。

translations.literal: In winter, the eleventh month, on xinyou, Sengbian halted at Gushu and at once remained to garrison there.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou in the eleventh month of winter Sengbian camped at Gushu and stayed to garrison it.

sentences.zh: 遣豫州刺史侯瑱據東關壘，征吳興太守裴之橫帥衆繼之。

translations.literal: He sent South Yu Inspector Hou Tian to hold the Dongguan rampart and summoned Wu Commandery Administrator Pei Zhiheng to lead a host in support.
translations.idiomatic: He sent South Yu inspector Hou Tian to hold the Dongguan fort and called Wuxing administrator Pei Zhiheng with troops to follow.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以尚書右僕射王褒爲尚書左僕射，湘東太守張綰爲尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: On wuxu, Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Wang Bao was made Left Vice Director; Xiangdong Administrator Zhang Gun was made Right Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Right Vice Director Wang Bao became Left Vice Director, and Xiangdong administrator Zhang Gun became Right Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 十二月，宿預土民東方光據城歸化，魏江西州郡皆起兵應之。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, the native elders of Suyu, Dongfang Guang, held the city and submitted; Wei's Jiangxi commanderies all rose in answer.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Dongfang Guang of Suyu, a local leader, held the city and came over; Wei's Jiangxi districts all rose in response.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月甲午，加南豫州刺史侯瑱征北將軍、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month, on jiawu, year 3, South Yu Inspector Hou Tian was advanced to General Who Pacifies the North, Opening Office Equal in Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu in the first month of spring, year 3, South Yu inspector Hou Tian was promoted to General Who Pacifies the North and Opening Office Equal in Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 陳霸先帥衆攻廣陵城。

translations.literal: Chen Baxian led his host to attack Guangling city.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Baxian led his army against Guangling.

sentences.zh: 秦州刺史嚴超達自秦郡圍涇州，侯瑱、張彪出石梁，爲其聲援。

translations.literal: Qin Province Inspector Yan Chaoda from Qin commandery besieged Jing Province; Hou Tian and Zhang Biao went out by Shiliang as a supporting force.
translations.idiomatic: Qinzhou inspector Yan Chaoda besieged Jingzhou from Qin commandery; Hou Tian and Zhang Biao marched out through Shiliang in support.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，陳霸先遣晉陵太守杜僧明率衆助東方光。

translations.literal: On xinchou, Chen Baxian sent Jinling Administrator Du Sengming to lead a host to aid Dongfang Guang.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Chen Baxian sent Jinling administrator Du Sengming with troops to aid Dongfang Guang.

sentences.zh: 三月甲辰，以司徒王僧辯爲太尉、車騎大將軍。

translations.literal: In the third month, on jiachen, Minister Over the Masses Wang Sengbian was made Grand Marshal and General of Chariots and Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen in the third month Minister Over the Masses Wang Sengbian was made Grand Marshal and General of Chariots and Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 丁未，魏遣將王球率衆七百攻宿預，杜僧明逆擊，大破之。

translations.literal: On dingwei, Wei sent General Wang Qiu with seven hundred men to attack Suyu; Du Sengming met them in counterattack and routed them utterly.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Wei sent General Wang Qiu with seven hundred men against Suyu; Du Sengming met them and broke them completely.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以護軍將軍、郢州刺史陸法和爲司徒。

translations.literal: On wushen, Protector-General and Yingzhou Inspector Lu Fahe was made Minister Over the Masses.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Protector-General and Yingzhou inspector Lu Fahe was made Minister Over the Masses.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸酉，以征北大將軍、開府儀同三司陳霸先爲司空。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on guiyou, General Who Pacifies the North, Opening Office Equal in Three Departments Chen Baxian was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou in the fourth month of summer General Who Pacifies the North Chen Baxian, Opening Office Equal in Three Departments, was made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 六月壬午，魏復遣將步六汗薩率衆救涇州。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on renwu, Wei again sent General Buluohan Sa with a host to relieve Jing Province.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu in the sixth month Wei again sent General Buluohan Sa with an army to relieve Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸未，有黑氣如龍，見于於殿內。

translations.literal: On guiwei, black vapor like a dragon was seen within the palace hall.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei black qi like a dragon appeared inside the palace hall.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲辰，以都官尚書宗懍爲吏部尚書。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on jiachen, Director of the Ministry of Justice Zong Lin was made Minister of Civil Appointments.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen in the seventh month of autumn Director of the Ministry of Justice Zong Lin was made Minister of Civil Appointments.

sentences.zh: 九月辛卯，世祖於龍光殿述《老子》義，尚書左僕射王褒爲執經。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on xinmao, Shizu expounded the meaning of the Laozi at the Dragon Light Hall; Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Wang Bao held the classics.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao in the ninth month Shizu lectured on the Laozi at Dragon Light Hall; Left Vice Director Wang Bao held the text.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，魏遣其柱國萬紐于謹率大衆來寇。

translations.literal: On yisi, Wei sent its Pillar of State Wan Niuyu Jin with a great host to invade.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Wei sent Pillar of State Wan Niuyu Jin with a great army against us.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙寅，魏軍至于襄陽，蕭詧率衆會之。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on bingyin, the Wei army reached Xiangyang; Xiao Cha led a host to join it.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin in the tenth month of winter the Wei army reached Xiangyang; Xiao Cha joined it with his forces.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，停講，內外戒嚴，輿駕出行都柵。

translations.literal: On dingmao, lectures ceased; within and without the palace were placed on alert, and the imperial carriage went out to the capital palisade.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao teaching stopped; court and camp were armed, and the emperor went out to the capital stockade.

sentences.zh: 是日，大風拔木，丙子，徵王僧辯等軍。

translations.literal: That day a great wind uprooted trees; on bingzi, Wang Sengbian's army and others were summoned.
translations.idiomatic: That day a great wind tore up trees; on bingzi Wang Sengbian and other armies were summoned.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙辰，徐世譜、任約退戍巴陵。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on bingchen, Xu Shipu and Ren Yue withdrew their garrisons from Baling.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen in the twelfth month Xu Shipu and Ren Yue pulled back from Baling.

sentences.zh: 辛未，西魏害世祖，遂崩焉，時年四十七。

translations.literal: On xinwei, Western Wei killed Shizu, and he thereupon died, aged forty-seven.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Western Wei killed Shizu, and he died at forty-seven.

sentences.zh: 太子元良、始安王方略皆見害。

translations.literal: Crown Prince Yuanliang and Prince of Shian Fang Lue were both killed.
translations.idiomatic: Crown Prince Yuanliang and Prince Fang Lue of Shian were both slain.

sentences.zh: 乃選百姓男女數萬口，分爲奴婢，驅入長安；

translations.literal: Then tens of thousands of common men and women were chosen, divided into slaves and maidservants, and driven into Chang'an;
translations.idiomatic: Then tens of thousands of men and women of the people were taken, divided into slaves and maidservants, and driven to Chang'an;

sentences.zh: 小弱者皆殺之。

translations.literal: the small and weak were all killed.
translations.idiomatic: the small and weak were all put to death.

sentences.zh: 明年四月，追尊爲孝元皇帝，廟曰世祖。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the following year he was posthumously honored as Emperor Xiaoyuan, with temple name Shizu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the next year he was posthumously titled Emperor Xiaoyuan, temple name Shizu.

sentences.zh: 世祖聰悟俊朗，天才英發。

translations.literal: Shizu was perceptive, quick, and handsome, with heaven-given brilliance bursting forth.
translations.idiomatic: Shizu was clever, handsome, and quick, with a heaven-sent brilliance.

sentences.zh: 年五歲，高祖問：「汝讀何書？

translations.literal: At age five, the Gaozu asked, "What book do you read?"
translations.idiomatic: At five the Gaozu asked, "What book are you reading?"

sentences.zh: 」對曰：「能誦《曲禮》。

translations.literal: He answered, "I can recite the Record of Rites."
translations.idiomatic: He answered, "I can recite the Record of Rites."

sentences.zh: 」高祖曰：「汝試言之。

translations.literal: The Gaozu said, "Try reciting it for me."
translations.idiomatic: The Gaozu said, "Recite some for me."

sentences.zh: 」卽誦上篇，左右莫不驚嘆。

translations.literal: He at once recited the first section, and none left or right failed to marvel.
translations.idiomatic: He recited the first section at once, and all around were astonished.

sentences.zh: 初生患眼，高祖自下意治之，遂盲一目，彌加愍愛。

translations.literal: At birth he had suffered from the eyes; the Gaozu himself attended to curing them, yet one eye was blinded—and all the more was he cherished in pitying love.
translations.idiomatic: Born with an eye ailment, the Gaozu treated it himself, yet one eye was left blind—and his affection only deepened.

sentences.zh: 旣長好學，博綜羣書，下筆成章，出言爲論，才辯敏速，冠絕一時。

translations.literal: When grown he loved learning, mastered many books, wrote essays at a stroke and spoke in structured argument; his talent, eloquence, and speed were unmatched in his age.
translations.idiomatic: Grown, he loved study, mastered many books, wrote at a stroke and spoke in reasoned discourse—none in his time matched his quick wit.

sentences.zh: 高祖嘗問曰：「孫策昔在江東，于時年幾？

translations.literal: The Gaozu once asked, "Sun Ce in his day on the Jiangdong—how old was he then?"
translations.idiomatic: The Gaozu once asked, "Sun Ce on the Jiangdong—how old was he?"

sentences.zh: 」答曰：「十七。

translations.literal: He answered, "Seventeen."
translations.idiomatic: He answered, "Seventeen."

sentences.zh: 」高祖曰：「正是汝年。

translations.literal: The Gaozu said, "That is exactly your age."
translations.idiomatic: The Gaozu said, "That is just your age."

sentences.zh: 」賀革爲府諮議，敕革講《三禮》。

translations.literal: He Ge served as staff adviser; an order was given for He Ge to lecture on the Three Rites.
translations.idiomatic: He Ge was staff adviser; the emperor ordered He Ge to lecture on the Three Rites.

sentences.zh: 世祖性不好聲色，頗有高名，與裴子野、劉顯、蕭子雲、張纘及當時才秀爲布衣之交，著述辭章，多行於世。

translations.literal: Shizu by nature did not care for music and the women's quarters; he bore a high reputation, and with Pei Ziye, Liu Xian, Xiao Ziyun, Zhang Zuan, and the talented men of the time he kept the friendship of plain cloth; his writings and compositions circulated widely in the world.
translations.idiomatic: Shizu cared little for music and women; he had a high name, and with Pei Ziye, Liu Xian, Xiao Ziyun, Zhang Zuan, and the day's finest men he kept friendships in plain dress; his writings circulated widely.

sentences.zh: 在尋陽，夢人曰：「天下將亂，王必維之。

translations.literal: At Xunyang he dreamed a man said, "The realm will fall into disorder—you, King, must hold it together."
translations.idiomatic: At Xunyang he dreamed a man said, "The realm will fall into chaos—you, King, must steady it."

sentences.zh: 」又背生黑子，巫媼見曰：「此大貴兆，當不可言。

translations.literal: A black mole also grew on his back; a shaman woman seeing it said, "This is a sign of the greatest nobility—it cannot be spoken."
translations.idiomatic: A black mole grew on his back; a shaman woman said, "This is a mark of supreme nobility—it must not be told."

sentences.zh: 」初，賀革西上，意甚不悅，過別御史中丞江革，以情告之。

translations.literal: Earlier, when He Ge went west he was deeply displeased; passing by he took leave of Censor-in-Chief Jiang Ge and told him his feelings.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier He Ge went west in deep displeasure; stopping to bid farewell to Censor-in-Chief Jiang Ge, he confided his mind.

sentences.zh: 革曰：「吾嘗夢主上遍見諸子，至湘東王，手脫帽授之。

translations.literal: Jiang Ge said, "I once dreamed the sovereign looked on all his sons; when he came to the Prince of Xiangdong he pulled off his cap and handed it to him.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Ge said, "I once dreamed the emperor saw all his sons; at the Prince of Xiangdong he removed his cap and gave it to him.

sentences.zh: 此人后必當璧，卿其行乎！

translations.literal: This man will surely receive the jade disk afterward—you should go!"
translations.idiomatic: This man will surely take the throne—you should go!"

sentences.zh: 」革從之。

translations.literal: He Ge followed his counsel.
translations.idiomatic: He Ge took his advice.

sentences.zh: 及太清之難，乃能克復，故遐邇樂推，遂膺寶命矣。

translations.literal: When the calamity of Taiqing came, he alone could recover the realm—therefore far and near gladly pushed him forward, and he received the precious mandate.
translations.idiomatic: When the Taiqing disaster struck, he alone could restore the land—so near and far acclaimed him, and he received the throne.

sentences.zh: 所著《孝德傳》三十卷，《忠臣傳》三十卷，《丹陽尹傳》十卷。

translations.literal: His works included Records of Filial Virtue in thirty scrolls, Records of Loyal Ministers in thirty scrolls, and Records of the Danyang Intendant in ten scrolls.
translations.idiomatic: He wrote Records of Filial Virtue in thirty juan, Records of Loyal Ministers in thirty juan, and Records of the Danyang Intendant in ten juan.

sentences.zh: 《注漢書》一百一十五卷，《周易講疏》十卷，《內典博要》一百卷，《連山》三十卷，《洞林》三卷，《玉韜》十卷，《補闕子》十卷，《老子講疏》四卷，《全德志》、《懷舊志》、《荊南志》、《江州記》、《貢職圖》、《古今同姓名錄》一卷，《筮經》十二卷，《式贊》三卷，文集五十卷。

translations.literal: Commentary on the Han History in one hundred fifteen scrolls, Exegesis of the Changes in ten scrolls, Essentials of the Inner Canon in one hundred scrolls, Linked Mountains in thirty scrolls, Cavern Forest in three scrolls, Jade Sheath in ten scrolls, Supplement to the Missing Master in ten scrolls, Exegesis of the Laozi in four scrolls, Records of Complete Virtue, Records of Old Friends, Records of Jingnan, Records of Jiang Province, Tribute Duties Illustrated, Register of Identical Names Ancient and Modern in one scroll, Classic of Divination in twelve scrolls, Praise of Forms in three scrolls, and collected writings in fifty scrolls.
translations.idiomatic: He also wrote Commentary on the Han History in 115 juan, Exegesis of the Changes in 10 juan, Essentials of the Inner Canon in 100 juan, Linked Mountains in 30 juan, Cavern Forest in 3 juan, Jade Sheath in 10 juan, Supplement to the Missing Master in 10 juan, Exegesis of the Laozi in 4 juan, Records of Complete Virtue, Records of Old Friends, Records of Jingnan, Records of Jiang Province, Tribute Duties Illustrated, Register of Identical Names Ancient and Modern in 1 juan, Classic of Divination in 12 juan, Praise of Forms in 3 juan, and collected works in 50 juan.

sentences.zh: 史臣曰：梁季之禍，巨寇憑壘，世祖時位長連率，有全楚之資，應身率羣后，枕戈先路。

translations.literal: The historiographer says: In the calamity of the Liang age, a great bandit leaned on his rampart; in his time Shizu held the long post of regional commander and possessed the full resources of Chu—he ought to have led the lords in person, pillowing his spear and taking the vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: The historiographer says: In the disaster of the Liang season a great robber held his fortress; Shizu then stood as chief regional commander with the whole strength of Chu—he should have led the feudal lords himself, spear at bedside, on the foremost road.

sentences.zh: 虛張外援，事異勤王，在於行師，曾非百舍。

translations.literal: He falsely inflated outside reinforcements; the affair differed from rallying troops to rescue the throne; in taking the field, he did not even travel a hundred overnight stops.
translations.idiomatic: He trumpeted outside aid that was not real; his campaign was not true rescue of the throne; on the march he did not even go a hundred stops.

sentences.zh: 後方殲夷大憝，用寧宗社，握圖南面，光啓中興，亦世祖雄才英略，紹茲寶運者也。

translations.literal: Only afterward did he destroy the great villain and secure altars and state; grasping the map facing south, he inaugurated restoration—this too was Shizu's heroic talent and brilliant strategy, continuing this precious mandate.
translations.idiomatic: Only later did he destroy the great villain and settle the realm; turning south to rule, he opened a restoration—a credit to Shizu's ability and strategy and to the mandate he inherited.

sentences.zh: 而稟性猜忌，不隔疏近，御下無術，履冰弗懼，故鳳闕伺晨之功，火無內照之美。

translations.literal: But by nature suspicious, making no distinction between distant and near, inept in governing subordinates, treading ice yet unafraid—therefore the Phoenix Tower dawn-watching achievement lacked fire's inner shining beauty.
translations.idiomatic: Yet he was suspicious by nature, alike toward kin near and far, inept with subordinates, reckless on thin ice—so the merit of watching dawn at the Phoenix Tower showed fire without inner light.

sentences.zh: 以世祖之神睿特達，留情政道，不怵邪說，徙蹕金陵，左鄰強寇，將何以作？

translations.literal: Given Shizu's divine wisdom and extraordinary penetration, his attention to governance and the Way, not cowed by heterodox doctrines—moving the imperial procession to Jinling with powerful enemies on the left, what could he accomplish?
translations.idiomatic: For all Shizu's brilliance and care for government, his refusal to heed bad counsel, and the move of the court to Jinling with strong foes beside him—what could he achieve?

sentences.zh: 是以天未悔禍，盪覆斯生，悲夫！

translations.literal: Thus Heaven had not yet repented of disaster; ruin overturned this life—alas!
translations.idiomatic: So Heaven had not yet turned from calamity, and ruin engulfed his reign—alas!
